translation: §eTurns Into§f - The type o' block the Jigsaw Block will turn into when placed in the world durin' structure generation.

source_string: §eSelection Priority§f - When the parent piece is being processed for connections, this is the order in which this Jigsaw block attempts to connect to its target piece. Jigsaws will be processed in descending priority with random ordering breaking ties.
translation: §eSelection Priority§f - When the parent piece be bein' processed fer connections, this be the order in which this Jigsaw block attempts to connect to its target piece. Jigsaws will be processed in descendin' priority with random orderin' breakin' ties.

source_string: §ePlacement Priority§f - When this Jigsaw block connects to a piece, this is the order in which that piece is processed for connections in the wider structure. Pieces will be processed in descending priority with insertion order breaking ties.
translation: §ePlacement Priority§f - When this Jigsaw block connects to a piece, this be the order in which that piece be processed fer connections in the wider structure. Pieces will be processed in descendin' priority with insertion order breakin' ties.

source_string: §eJoint Type§f - A joint can be either Rollable (default) or Aligned. If the joint type is Rollable, the target structure will be rotated randomly around the source Jigsaw Block. If the joint type is Aligned, the target structure will be placed such that the rotation of the target Jigsaw Block aligns with the rotation of the source Jigsaw Block. Note that this only applies when the Jigsaw Block is placed facing up or down.
translation: §eJoint Type§f - A joint can be either Rollable (default) or Aligned. If the joint type be Rollable, the target structure will be rotated randomly around the source Jigsaw Block. If the joint type be Aligned, the target structure will be placed such that the rotation o' the target Jigsaw Block aligns with the rotation o' the source Jigsaw Block. Note that this only applies when the Jigsaw Block be placed facin' up or down.

source_string: The Jukebox will play Music Discs that you have found.
translation: The Jukebox will play Music Discs that ye have found.

source_string: Press :_input_key.use: on a Jukebox with a Music Disc in your hand to play it. Press :_input_key.use: the Jukebox again to eject the Music Disc.
translation: Press :_input_key.use: on a Jukebox with a Music Disc in yer hand to play it. Press :_input_key.use: the Jukebox again to eject the Music Disc.

source_string: Tap a Jukebox with a Music Disc in your hand to play it. Tap the Jukebox again to eject the Music Disc.
translation: Tap a Jukebox with a Music Disc in yer hand to play it. Tap the Jukebox again to eject the Music Disc.

source_string: When a Jukebox is playing a Music Disc, it will power Redstone Dust.
translation: When a Jukebox be playin' a Music Disc, it'll power Redstone Dust.

source_string: Try different Music Discs for a different power level.
translation: Try different Music Discs fer a different power level.

source_string: See what happens when you let it play to the end.
translation: See what happens when ye let it play to the end.

source_string: A Hopper can put a Music Disc in for you, and take it out when it's done playing.
translation: A Hopper can put a Music Disc in fer ye, and take it out when it's done playin'.

source_string: There are a couple of Music Discs that can be found in Chests around the world.
translation: There be a couple o' Music Discs that can be found in Chests around the world.

source_string: Others are more difficult to come by, Creepers secretly appreciate music.
translation: Others be more difficult to come by, Creepers secretly appreciate music.

source_string: The Loom is a fast and efficient way to apply patterns to Banners. The Loom only uses one Dye to apply a pattern. It can also use Loom patterns to apply special patterns.
translation: The Loom be a fast and efficient way to apply patterns to Banners. The Loom only uses one Dye to apply a pattern. It can also use Loom patterns to apply special patterns.

source_string: By placing a Banner into the Loom's first slot, and any color dye into the second slot, patterns can be added to the Banner. Once a pattern is selected, take it from the output slot on the right and move it to your inventory.
translation: By placin' a Banner into the Loom's first slot, and any color dye into the second slot, patterns can be added to the Banner. Once a pattern be selected, take it from the output slot on the right and move it to yer inventory.

source_string: A Banner can have multiple layers allowing you to experiment with many different banner possibilities. Up to 6 patterns can be applied to a Banner to create a unique design.
translation: A Banner can have multiple layers allowin' ye to experiment with many different banner possibilities. Up to 6 patterns can be applied to a Banner to create a unique design.

source_string: Adding a Loom Pattern to the Loom's third slot will allow the crafting of special patterns like a creeper face or a flower pattern. You will not lose your Loom Patterns when you apply these patterns to your Banners.
translation: Addin' a Loom Pattern to the Loom's third slot will allow the craftin' o' special patterns like a creeper face or a flower pattern. Ye won't lose yer Loom Patterns when ye apply these patterns to yer Banners.

source_string: Explore thrilling themed worlds, parceled up with matching skins, textures and more!
translation: Explore thrillin' themed worlds, parceled up with matchin' skins, textures and more!

source_string: Explore a world of possibility with Minecoins: Minecraft's in-game currency! Minecoins let you add variety to your gameplat across supported Minecraft games.
translation: Explore a world o' possibility with Minecoins: Minecraft's in-game currency! Minecoins let ye add variety to yer gameplat across supported Minecraft games.

source_string: Once redeemed, your Minecoins are linked to your Microsoft account, so you can access your coins and purchases on other supported devices, too!
translation: Once redeemed, yer Minecoins be linked to yer Microsoft account, so ye can access yer coins and purchases on other supported devices, too!

source_string: *Minecoins require a version of Minecraft: Bedrock Edition with Minecraft Marketplace. Minecoins are not compatible on PlayStation®. For compatibility information see minecraft.net/minecoins
translation: *Minecoins require a version o' Minecraft: Bedrock Edition with Minecraft Marketplace. Minecoins ain't compatible on PlayStation®. Fer compatibility information see minecraft.net/minecoins

source_string: Not all crafting materials are on the surface - some may require you to dig underground or into a mountain.
translation: Not all craftin' materials be on the surface - some may require ye to dig underground or into a mountain.

source_string: A §epickaxe§f:wood_pickaxe: helps you uncover all sorts of materials, such as stone, coal, iron, and precious ore - though you may need extra sturdy tools for some rarer materials!
translation: A §epickaxe§f:wood_pickaxe: helps ye uncover all sorts o' materials, such as stone, coal, iron, and precious ore - though ye may need extra sturdy tools fer some rarer materials!

source_string: Some raw metals will need to be smelted using a §efurnace§f:furnace: . Place a fuel like coal or wood logs in the fuel slot, then add raw ore to smelt it into something useful.
translation: Some raw metals will need to be smelted usin' a §efurnace§f:furnace: . Place a fuel like coal or wood logs in the fuel slot, then add raw ore to smelt it into somethin' useful.

source_string: A player can ride any adult §eHorse§f, §eDonkey§f, §eMule§f, or §eCamel§f. Only Horses can be armored.
translation: A crewmate can ride any adult §eHorse§f, §eDonkey§f, §eMule§f, or §eCamel§f. Only Horses can be armored.

source_string: Mules and Donkeys may be equipped with saddlebags (for transporting items) by attaching a Chest. These saddlebags can then be accessed whilst riding or sneaking.
translation: Mules and Donkeys may be equipped with saddlebags (fer transportin' items) by attachin' a Chest. These saddlebags can then be accessed whilst ridin' or sneakin'.

source_string: Horses, Donkeys, and Mules must be §etamed§f before they can be used. A player can tame a horse by riding it and staying on while it tries to buck them off. Press :_input_key.use: with an empty hand to attempt to tame Horses, Donkeys, and Mules.
translation: Horses, Donkeys, and Mules must be §etamed§f before they can be used. A player can tame a horse by ridin' it and stayin' on while it tries to buck 'em off. Press :_input_key.use: with an empty hand to attempt to tame Horses, Donkeys, and Mules.

source_string: Horses, Donkeys, and Mules must be §etamed§f before they can be used. A player can tame a horse by riding it and staying on while it tries to buck them off. Tap the Mount button that appears when near a horse  to attempt to tame Horses, Donkeys, and Mules.
translation: Horses, Donkeys, and Mules must be §etamed§f before they can be used. A player can tame a horse by ridin' it and stayin' on while it tries to buck 'em off. Tap the Mount button that appears when near a horse  to attempt to tame Horses, Donkeys, and Mules.

source_string: When Hearts appear around the horse, it has been tamed and will no longer attempt to throw the player off.
translation: When Hearts appear around the horse, it's been tamed and won't try to throw the rider off no more.

source_string: To steer horses and camels, the player must equip it with a §eSaddle§f.
translation: To steer horses and camels, ye must equip 'em with a §eSaddle§f.

source_string: Saddles can be bought from villagers, found inside Chests hidden in the world, or acquired by fishing. While riding a horse, open your inventory and put a saddle in the horse's saddle slot.
translation: Saddles can be bought from villagers, found inside Chests hidden in the world, or acquired by fishin'. While ridin' a horse, open yer inventory and put a saddle in the horse's saddle slot.

source_string: A camel can carry two players at the same time.
translation: A camel can carry two crewmates at the same time.

source_string: Horses and Donkeys can be bred like other animals using Golden Apples or Golden Carrots.
translation: Horses and Donkeys can be bred like other animals usin' Golden Apples or Golden Carrots.

source_string: Foals will grow into adult horses over time, although feeding them Wheat or Hay will speed this up.
translation: Foals will grow into adult horses over time, although feedin' 'em Wheat or Hay will speed this up.

source_string: Llamas are another ridable mob which can be tamed and used to transport large shipments of items.
translation: Llamas be another ridable mob which can be tamed and used to transport large shipments o' items.

source_string: Llamas can be tamed the same as horses. However, even when tamed, the player can't control their movements when riding them.
translation: Llamas can be tamed the same as horses. However, even when tamed, the player can't control their movements when ridin' 'em.

source_string: A lead can be attached to one, and when this happens, surrounding llamas (both tamed and un-tamed) will follow, making a caravan.
translation: A lead can be attached to one, and when this happens, surroundin' llamas (both tamed and un-tamed) will follow, makin' a caravan.

source_string: Llamas can be equipped with chests, giving it 3-15 slots of inventory space depending on the strength of the Llama. They can also be equipped with carpets. Each carpet color yields a different pattern.
translation: Llamas can be equipped with chests, givin' it 3-15 slots o' inventory space dependin' on the strength o' the Llama. They can also be equipped with carpets. Each carpet color yields a different pattern.

source_string: Pigs can be ridden as well, although they won't go where you want without a little incentive.
translation: Pigs can be ridden as well, although they won't go where ye want without a little incentive.

source_string: Equip a pig with a Saddle and point a Carrot on a Stick in the direction you want to go.
translation: Equip a pig with a Saddle and point a Carrot on a Stick in the direction ye want to go.

source_string: When using the D-Pad control scheme, tap :touch_jump: to dismount an animal.
translation: When usin' the D-Pad control scheme, tap :touch_jump: to dismount an animal.

source_string: When using a Joystick control scheme, tap :tip_virtual_button_dismount: to dismount an animal.
translation: When usin' a Joystick control scheme, tap :tip_virtual_button_dismount: to dismount an animal.

source_string: Welcome to the Overworld, a blocky world full of adventure and possibility!
translation: Welcome to the Overworld, a blocky world full o' adventure and possibility!

source_string: Look around by touching and dragging the screen.
translation: Look around by touchin' and draggin' the screen.

source_string: Move around the world using the on-screen joystick:tip_virtual_joystick: .
translation: Move around the world usin' the on-screen joystick:tip_virtual_joystick: .

source_string: Move around the world using the on-screen buttons.
translation: Move around the world usin' the on-screen buttons.

source_string: Move around the world using the on-screen joystick:tip_virtual_joystick: .
translation: Move around the world usin' the on-screen joystick:tip_virtual_joystick: .

source_string: The world is full of resources, including §ebuilding blocks§f, §ecrafting materials§f, and §efood§f.
translation: The world be full o' resources, includin' §ebuildin' blocks§f, §ecraftin' materials§f, and §efood§f.

source_string: You can §ebreak blocks§f with your bare hands to gather resources like dirt and wood. Aim at a block, then §epress and hold§f :_input_key.attack:  until it breaks and the resources drop.
translation: Ye can §ebreak blocks§f with yer bare hands to gather resources like dirt and wood. Aim at a block, then §epress and hold§f :_input_key.attack:  until it breaks and the resources drop.

source_string: You can §ebreak blocks§f with your bare hands to gather resources like dirt and wood. §eTouch and hold§f on the block until it breaks and the resources drop.
translation: Ye can §ebreak blocks§f with yer bare hands to gather resources like dirt and wood. §eTouch and hold§f on the block until it breaks and the resources drop.

source_string: You can §ebreak blocks§f with your bare hands to gather resources like dirt and wood. Aim at a block, then §etouch and hold§f :tip_virtual_button_action_attack_or_destroy:  until it breaks and the resources drop.
translation: Ye can §ebreak blocks§f with yer bare hands to gather resources like dirt and wood. Aim at a block, then §etouch and hold§f :tip_virtual_button_action_attack_or_destroy:  until it breaks and the resources drop.

source_string: You can §ebreak blocks§f with your bare hands to gather resources like dirt and wood. Aim at a block, then §eclick and hold§f :_input_key.attack:  until it breaks and the resources drop.
translation: Ye can §ebreak blocks§f with yer bare hands to gather resources like dirt and wood. Aim at a block, then §eclick and hold§f :_input_key.attack:  until it breaks and the resources drop.

source_string: Pick up any dropped resources by walking over the floating icons.
translation: Pick up any dropped resources by walkin' over the floatin' icons.

source_string: Resources you pick up will appear in your §ehotbar§f, which you'll find at the bottom of the screen.
translation: Resources ye pick up will appear in yer §ehotbar§f, which ye'll find at the bottom o' the screen.

source_string: To hold an item in your hand, scroll the mouse wheel to select the item. You can also use a number key: 1 is the first hotbar slot and 9 is the last.
translation: To hold an item in yer hand, scroll the mouse wheel to select the item. Ye can also use a number key: 1 be the first hotbar slot and 9 be the last.

source_string: To hold an item in your hand, use :_input_key.cycleItemLeft: and :_input_key.cycleItemRight: to select the item.
translation: To hold an item in yer hand, use :_input_key.cycleItemLeft: and :_input_key.cycleItemRight: to select the item.

source_string: To hold an item in your hand, simply tap it in the hotbar.
translation: To hold an item in yer hand, simply tap it in the hotbar.

source_string: To hold an item in your hand, use :rift_left_trigger: and :rift_left_grab: to select the item.
translation: To hold an item in yer hand, use :rift_left_trigger: and :rift_left_grab: to select the item.

source_string: To hold an item in your hand, use :windowsmr_left_touchpad_horizontal: to select the item.
translation: To hold an item in yer hand, use :windowsmr_left_touchpad_horizontal: to select the item.

source_string: Some items, like buckets, fishing rods, and bows, can be used by tapping the build/use button :_input_key.use:.
translation: Some items, like buckets, fishin' rods, and bows, can be used by tappin' the build/use button :_input_key.use:.

source_string: Some items, like buckets, fishing rods, and bows, can be used by touching and holding anywhere on the screen.
translation: Some items, like buckets, fishin' rods, and bows, can be used by touchin' and holdin' anywhere on the screen.

source_string: Some items, like buckets, fishing rods, and bows, can be used by tapping the build/use button :tip_virtual_button_action_build_or_use:.
translation: Some items, like buckets, fishin' rods, and bows, can be used by tappin' the build/use button :tip_virtual_button_action_build_or_use:.

source_string: Any block you've picked up can placed back into the world. This way you can build a cozy §eshelter§f or anything else you can imagine!
translation: Any block ye've picked up can placed back into the world. This way ye can build a cozy §eshelter§f or anything else ye can imagine!

source_string: Choose a block in your hotbar, then press :_input_key.use: to place it.
translation: Choose a block in yer hotbar, then press :_input_key.use: to place it.

source_string: Tap a block in your hotbar to select it, then tap somewhere in the world to place it.
translation: Tap a block in yer hotbar to select it, then tap somewhere in the world to place it.

source_string: Tap a block in your hotbar to select it, then tap :tip_virtual_button_action_build_or_use: to place it.
translation: Tap a block in yer hotbar to select it, then tap :tip_virtual_button_action_build_or_use: to place it.

source_string: Don't worry if you place something in the wrong spot - simply break it again, then pick it back up!
translation: Don't worry if ye place somethin' in the wrong spot - simply break it again, then pick it back up!

source_string: Navigation is an important skill that you will learn in Minecraft as it's not always easy to find your way home.
translation: Navigation be an important skill that ye'll learn in Minecraft as it's not always easy to find yer way home.

source_string: First of all, there are some basic tools that you should know about.
translation: First o' all, there be some basic tools that ye should know about.

source_string: A Compass will point in the direction of the first place you spawned into the world, an easy way to find where you started.
translation: A Compass will point in the direction o' the first place ye spawned into the world, an easy way to find where ye started.

source_string: A Map lets you see the area you've explored. Put it in your offhand slot to use it like a mini-map. You can increase its size by adding more paper to the edges in a Crafting Table.
translation: A Map lets ye see the area ye've explored. Put it in yer offhand slot to use it like a mini-map. Ye can increase its size by addin' more paper to the edges in a Craftin' Table.

source_string: A Locator Map will show you where you are and what direction you are facing in relation to the Locator Map's origin. It will also show you the location of other players in the same world.
translation: A Locator Map will show ye where ye be and what direction ye be facin' in relation to the Locator Map's origin. It'll also show ye the location o' other players in the same world.

source_string: A Cartography Table can help you create, expand, copy and even name maps.
translation: A Cartography Table can help ye create, expand, copy and even name maps.

source_string: Place paper into the first slot to craft a Map. If you add a compass into the second slot you can craft a Locator Map. Adding Paper or a blank Map will let you expand or copy your Map.
translation: Place paper into the first slot to craft a Map. If ye add a compass into the second slot ye can craft a Locator Map. Addin' Paper or a blank Map will let ye expand or copy yer Map.

source_string: Try to watch for landmarks as you explore. The more you play on a world, the more you will be able to remember where you are. Another good trick is to place Torches as you go so that you may find your way back home.
translation: Try to watch fer landmarks as ye explore. The more ye play on a world, the more ye'll be able to remember where ye be. Another good trick be to place Torches as ye go so that ye may find yer way back home.

source_string: The sun can also tell you what direction you are facing. Remember: the sun rises in the east and sets in the west!
translation: The sun can also tell ye what direction ye be facin'. Remember: the sun rises in the east and sets in the west!

source_string: There are several places for you to explore. Find a village and look for a Cartographer. He will trade you Explorer Maps that will lead you to strange places very far away.
translation: There be several places fer ye to explore. Find a village and look fer a Cartographer. He'll trade ye Explorer Maps that will lead ye to strange places very far away.

source_string: A Nether Portal allows you to travel to a different dimension.
translation: A Nether Portal allows ye to travel to a different dimension.

source_string: If constructed correctly the Nether Portal can be lit and activated.
translation: If built right, the Nether Portal can be lit and activated.

source_string: Example of a portal construction shown here:
translation: Example o' a portal construction shown here:

source_string: In Minecraft, the sun rises and sets as you adventure in your world. As the sun sets, you must take precautions. There are many dangers at night!
translation: In Minecraft, the sun rises and sets as ye adventure in yer world. As the sun sets, ye must take precautions. There be many dangers at night!

source_string: If you have not already, you will need a place to take shelter from the dark and what lurks within it. This can be as simple as a hole in the side of a hill or a small cabin in the forest.
translation: If ye have not already, ye'll need a place to take shelter from the dark and what lurks within it. This can be as simple as a hole in the side o' a hill or a small cabin in the forest.

source_string: Be sure to block off all entrances, you may want to use a door so you can go in and out. If you have made a bed this is a good place to put it along with your Crafting Table and Furnace.
translation: Be sure to block off all entrances, ye may want to use a door so ye can go in and out. If ye have made a bed this be a good place to put it along with yer Craftin' Table and Furnace.

source_string: Also be sure to light up the area with torches, it may save your life.
translation: Also be sure to light up the area with torches, it may save yer life.

source_string: When the sun starts to set, it's time to get ready.
translation: When the sun starts to set, it's time to get ready.

source_string: At night, the Overworld is home to zombies, spiders, skeletons, and other dangerous creatures we call §ehostile mobs§f.
translation: At night, the Overworld be home to zombies, spiders, skeletons, and other dangerous creatures we call §ehostile mobs§f.

source_string: Crafting some §etorches§f can help you see in the dark, while also keeping mobs from spawning too close.
translation: Craftin' some §etorches§f can help ye see in the dark, while also keepin' mobs from spawnin' too close.

source_string: While holding a torch, place it into the world by right-clicking a nearby free surface.
translation: While holdin' a torch, place it into the world by right-clickin' a nearby free surface.

source_string: While holding a torch, place it into the world by pressing :_input_key.use:.
translation: While holdin' a torch, place it into the world by pressin' :_input_key.use:.

source_string: While holding a torch, place it into the world by tapping a nearby free surface.
translation: While holdin' a torch, place it into the world by tappin' a nearby free surface.

source_string: While holding a torch, place it into the world by aiming at a nearby block and tapping :tip_virtual_button_action_build_or_use:.
translation: While holdin' a torch, place it into the world by aimin' at a nearby block and tappin' :tip_virtual_button_action_build_or_use:.

source_string: There are several mobs in Minecraft that you can tame and make your pet. Each can be tamed by giving them an item that they like. Once tamed you can have them stay by pressing :_input_key.use: while looking at them.
translation: There be several mobs in Minecraft that ye can tame and make yer pet. Each can be tamed by givin' 'em an item that they like. Once tamed ye can have 'em stay by pressin' :_input_key.use: while lookin' at 'em.

source_string: There are several mobs in Minecraft that you can tame and make your pet. Each can be tamed by giving them an item that they like. Once tamed you can have them stay by tapping the Sit Button.
translation: There be several mobs in Minecraft that ye can tame and make yer pet. Each can be tamed by givin' 'em an item that they like. Once tamed ye can have 'em stay by tappin' the Sit Button.

source_string: Wolves are a neutral mob that hunt in the colder climates. They will attack Rabbits, Skeletons, and Sheep but run away from Llamas. They won't attack you unless you provoke them. You can tame them by giving them Bones.
translation: Wolves be a neutral mob that hunt in the colder climates. They'll attack Rabbits, Skeletons, and Sheep but run away from Llamas. They won't attack ye unless ye provoke 'em. Ye can tame 'em by givin' 'em Bones.

source_string: Cats are a neutral mob that can be found in villages. They will attack Rabbits and Baby Turtles. They will also keep Phantoms and Creepers away. They will try to run from you so taming them can be tough. They like fish so give them Raw Cod or Salmon to tame them.
translation: Cats be a neutral mob that can be found in villages. They'll attack Rabbits and Baby Turtles. They'll also keep Phantoms and Creepers away. They'll try to run from ye so tamin' 'em can be tough. They like fish so give 'em Raw Cod or Salmon to tame 'em.

source_string: Parrots are a passive mob that live in the Jungle. They will imitate any other mob in the area. Seeds are their favorite, give them a few to tame them. Parrots will also sit on your shoulder... Yes, you can have more than one up there.
translation: Parrots be a passive mob that live in the Jungle. They'll imitate any other mob in the area. Seeds be their favorite, give 'em a few to tame 'em. Parrots will also sit on yer shoulder... Aye, ye can have more than one up there.

source_string: While exploring the world you may encounter a Pillager encampment or patrol. Pillagers are always looking for villages to raid. Taking their Banners will get their attention, and they may choose to attack a nearby village.
translation: While explorin' the world ye may encounter a Pillager encampment or patrol. Pillagers be always lookin' fer villages to raid. Takin' their Banners will get their attention, and they may choose to attack a nearby village.

source_string: Be sure to defend your village, the attack will stop if you defeat all the raiders.
translation: Be sure to defend yer village, the attack will stop if ye defeat all the raiders.

source_string: Villagers will most likely be very grateful that you have saved them from the raiders. Be sure to check back with them, you might get a good deal.
translation: Villagers will most likely be very grateful that ye have saved 'em from the raiders. Be sure to check back with 'em, ye might get a good deal.

source_string: In Minecraft, you can have your own ranch filled with livestock! Ranching provides lots of resources such as wool, eggs, and raw meat.
translation: In Minecraft, ye can have yer own ranch filled with livestock! Ranchin' provides lots o' resources such as wool, eggs, and raw meat.

source_string: In order to keep your livestock growing, you have to make baby animals. Adult animals must enter Love Mode for this to happen. Feed the animals their preferred food to get them to enter Love Mode.
translation: In order to keep yer livestock growin', ye have to make baby animals. Adult animals must enter Love Mode fer this to happen. Feed the animals their preferred food to get 'em to enter Love Mode.

source_string: When two like animals are nearby and in Love Mode, they will kiss for a moment and then a baby animal will appear! The baby animal will stay with their parents until they grow into an adult. After having a baby, adult animals must wait 1 minute before entering Love Mode.
translation: When two like animals be nearby and in Love Mode, they'll kiss fer a moment and then a baby animal will appear! The baby animal will stay with their parents until they grow into an adult. After havin' a baby, adult animals must wait 1 minute before enterin' Love Mode.

source_string: Cows, mooshrooms, and sheep all eat Wheat. Pigs can eat Carrots or Beetroot. Chickens love Seeds of any kinds. Rabbits will eat Carrots, Golden Carrots, or Dandelions. Ocelots enjoy Raw Cod or Salmon. Wolves like to eat any kind of meat.
translation: Cows, mooshrooms, and sheep all eat Wheat. Pigs can eat Carrots or Beetroot. Chickens love Seeds o' any kinds. Rabbits will eat Carrots, Golden Carrots, or Dandelions. Ocelots enjoy Raw Cod or Salmon. Wolves like to eat any kind o' meat.

source_string: Animals will follow you when you hold their desired food item. This will help you lead them to your ranch or another animal.
translation: Animals will follow ye when ye hold their desired food item. This will help ye lead 'em to yer ranch or another animal.

source_string: Don't worry, you don't need to remember every recipe by heart. The §erecipe book§f in your inventory keeps track of blocks and items you can craft - simply click a recipe to see what you need to craft it.
translation: Don't worry, ye don't need to remember every recipe by heart. The §erecipe book§f in yer inventory keeps track o' blocks and items ye can craft - simply click a recipe to see what ye need to craft it.

source_string: Don't worry, you don't need to remember every recipe by heart. The §erecipe book§f in your inventory keeps track of blocks and items you can craft - simply select a recipe to see what you need to craft it.
translation: Don't worry, ye don't need to remember every recipe by heart. The §erecipe book§f in yer inventory keeps track o' blocks and items ye can craft - simply select a recipe to see what ye need to craft it.

source_string: Don't worry, you don't need to remember every recipe by heart. The §erecipe book§f in your inventory keeps track of blocks and items you can craft - simply tap a recipe to see what you need to craft it.
translation: Don't worry, ye don't need to remember every recipe by heart. The §erecipe book§f in yer inventory keeps track o' blocks and items ye can craft - simply tap a recipe to see what ye need to craft it.

source_string: Once you've gathered the required crafting ingredients, click the recipe once more, then move it from the output slot to your hotbar or inventory.
translation: Once ye've gathered the required craftin' ingredients, click the recipe once more, then move it from the output slot to yer hotbar or inventory.

source_string: Once you've gathered the required crafting ingredients, select the recipe once more, then move it from the output slot to your hotbar or inventory.
translation: Once ye've gathered the required craftin' ingredients, select the recipe once more, then move it from the output slot to yer hotbar or inventory.

source_string: Once you've gathered the required crafting ingredients, tap the recipe once more, then move it from the output slot to your hotbar or inventory.
translation: Once ye've gathered the required craftin' ingredients, tap the recipe once more, then move it from the output slot to yer hotbar or inventory.

source_string: Redstone Dust comes from Redstone Ore. This dust transmits an electrical signal. When it has power it lights up and transmits its signal to other Redstone items that are next to it.
translation: Redstone Dust comes from Redstone Ore. This dust transmits an electrical signal. When it has power it lights up and transmits its signal to other Redstone items that be next to it.

source_string: In order for one of these items to be powered, it needs a power source such as a Lever, Button, or Pressure Plate. Experiment to find them all!
translation: In order fer one o' these items to be powered, it needs a power source such as a Lever, Button, or Pressure Plate. Experiment to find 'em all!

source_string: Place some Redstone Dust next to a power source and turn it on to power it.
translation: Place some Redstone Dust next to a power source and turn it on to power it.

source_string: There are many items that use a Redstone signal to do something, such as a Hopper or a Piston.
translation: There be many items that use a Redstone signal to do somethin', such as a Hopper or a Piston.

source_string: Redstone allows for endless possibilities! Try creating something useful for yourself like an automatic farm!
translation: Redstone allows fer endless possibilities! Try creatin' somethin' useful fer yerself like an automatic farm!

source_string: A social hub for you and all the members of the Realm. Share your adventures and creations by posting stories to the Story Feed, like and comment to celebrate stories posted by other members.
translation: A social hub fer ye and all the members o' the Realm. Share yer adventures and creations by postin' stories to the Story Feed, like and comment to celebrate stories posted by other members.

source_string: Clicking the ADD STORY button on the Story Feed will let you write a story of your own. You can choose to include a screenshot or text (or both!). Clicking the POST button will post your text/screenshot to the Story Feed for all the Realm's members to enjoy. If you don't have any screenshots to post, use the §ecamera§f:camera: on the game menu to capture the moment.
translation: Clickin' the ADD STORY button on the Story Feed will let ye write a story o' yer own. Ye can choose to include a screenshot or text (or both!). Clickin' the POST button will post yer text/screenshot to the Story Feed fer all the Realm's members to enjoy. If ye don't have any screenshots to post, use the §ecamera§f:camera: on the game menu to capture the moment.

source_string: Whenever there is a new story in the Feed that you haven't read yet, a number will appear on the REALMS STORIES button. You'll always know when there is something new to read from your Realm's community. If you like what someone shared, go ahead and leave them a like or comment on their story!
translation: Whenever there be a new story in the Feed that ye haven't read yet, a number will appear on the REALMS STORIES button. Ye'll always know when there be somethin' new to read from yer Realm's community. If ye like what someone shared, go ahead and leave 'em a like or comment on their story!

source_string: See who's playing and when in the Timeline. Scroll through the members of the Realm to see when they played last and who they played with. Use this information to set up times when you can all play together.
translation: See who's playin' and when in the Timeline. Scroll through the members o' the Realm to see when they played last and who they played with. Use this information to set up times when ye can all play together.

source_string: Know who is on the Realm
translation: Know who be on the Realm

source_string: Get to know who is part of the Realm by using the Members tab. It's a list of all the players who can play here. You can see who the Realm owner is, who the operators are, and who has joined Realms Stories for this Realm. There are search, sort, and filter options to help you find exactly who you're looking for.
translation: Get to know who be part o' the Realm by usin' the Members tab. It's a list o' all the players who can play here. Ye can see who the Realm owner be, who the operators be, and who has joined Realms Stories fer this Realm. There be search, sort, and filter options to help ye find exactly who ye're lookin' fer.

source_string: Realms Stories is available in the game menu when you're playing in the Realm and on the Realms Tab. You can keep up to date and tell your story from anywhere you are, even when you aren't playing. From your console, computer, and mobile device, Realms Stories is available everywhere.
translation: Realms Stories be available in the game menu when ye're playin' in the Realm and on the Realms Tab. Ye can keep up to date and tell yer story from anywhere ye be, even when ye ain't playin'. From yer console, computer, and mobile device, Realms Stories be available everywhere.

source_string: Scaffolding can help you create huge structures safely! You can walk inside scaffolding and stand on it. If you have a column of scaffolding you can go upward by standing in the scaffolding and pressing :_input_key.jump:. If you want to travel downward you can press :_input_key.sneak:.
translation: Scaffoldin' can help ye create huge structures safely! Ye can walk inside scaffoldin' and stand on it. If ye have a column o' scaffoldin' ye can go upward by standin' in the scaffoldin' and pressin' :_input_key.jump:. If ye want to travel downward ye can press :_input_key.sneak:.

source_string: Scaffolding can help you create huge structures safely! You can walk inside scaffolding and stand on it. If you have a column of scaffolding you can go upward by standing in the scaffolding and pressing :_input_key.jump:. If you want to travel downward you can press and hold :_input_key.sneak:.
translation: Scaffoldin' can help ye create huge structures safely! Ye can walk inside scaffoldin' and stand on it. If ye have a column o' scaffoldin' ye can go upward by standin' in the scaffoldin' and pressin' :_input_key.jump:. If ye want to travel downward ye can press and hold :_input_key.sneak:.

source_string: Scaffolding can help with building large structures by offering a way to reach higher places and safely descend without taking fall damage.
translation: Scaffoldin' can help with buildin' large structures by offerin' a way to reach higher places and safely descend without takin' fall damage.

source_string: When using the D-Pad control scheme, tap :touch_jump: to climb up a column of scaffolding. Tap :touch_fly_down: to climb down.
translation: When usin' the D-Pad control scheme, tap :touch_jump: to climb up a column o' scaffoldin'. Tap :touch_fly_down: to climb down.

source_string: When using a Joystick control scheme, press :tip_virtual_button_jump: to climb up a column of scaffolding. Tap :tip_virtual_button_sneak: to climb down.
translation: When usin' a Joystick control scheme, press :tip_virtual_button_jump: to climb up a column o' scaffoldin'. Tap :tip_virtual_button_sneak: to climb down.

source_string: Scaffolding can help you create huge structures safely! You can walk inside scaffolding and stand on it. If you have a column of scaffolding you can go upward by standing in the scaffolding and pressing :rift_A:. If you want to travel downward you can press and hold :rift_X:.
translation: Scaffoldin' can help ye create huge structures safely! Ye can walk inside scaffoldin' and stand on it. If ye have a column o' scaffoldin' ye can go upward by standin' in the scaffoldin' and pressin' :rift_A:. If ye want to travel downward ye can press and hold :rift_X:.

source_string: Scaffolding can help you create huge structures safely! You can walk inside scaffolding and stand on it. If you have a column of scaffolding you can go upward by standing in the scaffolding and pressing :windowsmr_right_touchpad:. If you want to travel downward you can press and hold :windowsmr_right_stick:.
translation: Scaffoldin' can help ye create huge structures safely! Ye can walk inside scaffoldin' and stand on it. If ye have a column o' scaffoldin' ye can go upward by standin' in the scaffoldin' and pressin' :windowsmr_right_touchpad:. If ye want to travel downward ye can press and hold :windowsmr_right_stick:.

source_string: Scaffolding needs support. You can only place so many scaffolding horizontally without touching a different block. When you attempt to place too many scaffolding blocks without proper support, it will fall. Scaffolding can be placed like normal blocks, but it can also be placed on its own foundation to quickly build a tall tower.
translation: Scaffoldin' needs support. Ye can only place so many scaffoldin' horizontally without touchin' a different block. When ye attempt to place too many scaffoldin' blocks without proper support, it'll fall. Scaffoldin' can be placed like normal blocks, but it can also be placed on its own foundation to quickly build a tall tower.

source_string: When Scaffolding is broken it will also break every Scaffolding block that was being supported by it. This will let you quickly clean up your scaffolding by breaking the supporting blocks!
translation: When Scaffoldin' be broken it'll also break every Scaffoldin' block that was bein' supported by it. This will let ye quickly clean up yer scaffoldin' by breakin' the supportin' blocks!

source_string: Put on some fresh pixels and express yourself with a huge variety of inspired looks.
translation: Put on some fresh pixels and express yerself with a huge variety o' inspired looks.

source_string: Structure Blocks give creators the ability to copy and save out sections of their world into structures. Saved structures can then be pasted back into the world.
translation: Structure Blocks give creators the ability to copy and save out sections o' their world into structures. Saved structures can then be pasted back into the world.

source_string: To get a Structure Block you must use the /give slash command. To use a Structure Block, you must have Operator permissions.
translation: To get a Structure Block ye must use the /give slash command. To use a Structure Block, ye must have Operator permissions.

source_string: Structure Blocks have 4 modes that can be switched between with the Mode dropdown: Save, Load, Corner, and 3D Export.
translation: Structure Blocks have 4 modes that can be switched between with the Mode dropdown: Save, Load, Corner, and 3D Export.

source_string: Save mode saves an area of the world as a structure.
translation: Save mode saves an area o' the world as a structure.

source_string: Load mode loads a structure into the world. Only structures saved to the world or included in a behavior pack that is applied to the world can be loaded.
translation: Load mode loads a structure into the world. Only structures saved to the world or included in a behavior pack that be applied to the world can be loaded.

source_string: Corner mode is used with save mode's detect button to automatically set the area you want to save. See the Corner Mode section below for more details.
translation: Corner mode be used with save mode's detect button to automatically set the area ye want to save. See the Corner Mode section below fer more details.

source_string: 3D Export exports a 3D model file on supported platforms.
translation: 3D Export exports a 3D model file on supported platforms.

source_string: On the right side of the Structure Block screen, a preview of the area you have selected or the structure to load will appear depending on the mode the block is in.
translation: On the right side o' the Structure Block screen, a preview o' the area ye have selected or the structure to load will appear dependin' on the mode the block be in.

source_string: Press :_input_key.attack: and drag, to rotate the 3D preview.
translation: Press :_input_key.attack: and drag, to rotate the 3D preview.

source_string: Touch and drag on the preview to rotate the 3D preview.
translation: Touch and drag on the preview to rotate the 3D preview.

source_string: Redstone can be used to activate a Structure Block. This will cause it to either save a structure out or load a structure into the world, depending on the mode of the block and its settings.
translation: Redstone can be used to activate a Structure Block. This will cause it to either save a structure out or load a structure into the world, dependin' on the mode o' the block and its settings.

source_string: You can change how much of a structure is loaded in by changing the values for Integrity and Seed.
translation: Ye can change how much o' a structure be loaded in by changin' the values fer Integrity and Seed.

source_string: Integrity - the percentage of blocks to load in from the structure, accepted values are 0 to 100. Blocks will be chosen randomly if a Seed is not specified.
translation: Integrity - the percentage o' blocks to load in from the structure, accepted values be 0 to 100. Blocks will be chosen randomly if a Seed ain't specified.

source_string: Seed - the value entered here will determine which blocks to remove when using Integrity. Leave this field blank if you want the blocks to be chosen randomly.
translation: Seed - the value entered here will determine which blocks to remove when usin' Integrity. Leave this field blank if ye want the blocks to be chosen randomly.

source_string: When a structure with Structure Void blocks is loaded into the world, any block that would have been removed where the structure void block is loading into, will instead stay in the world.
translation: When a structure with Structure Void blocks be loaded into the world, any block that would have been removed where the structure void block be loadin' into, will instead stay in the world.

source_string: Example: loading an empty shipwreck into the bottom of the ocean will normally copy air over the water blocks. If the shipwreck was filled with structure void, then the water will stay, and you will have a shipwreck filled with water.
translation: Example: loadin' an empty shipwreck into the bottom o' the ocean will normally copy air over the water blocks. If the shipwreck was filled with structure void, then the water will stay, and ye'll have a shipwreck filled with water.

source_string: To automatically select the area you want to save, you can place Corner Mode blocks around your structure and name them with the same name as the structure you want to save.
translation: To automatically select the area ye want to save, ye can place Corner Mode blocks around yer structure and name 'em with the same name as the structure ye want to save.

source_string: Pressing the Detect button in Save mode will find all of the Corner Blocks with the same name and create a selection area so that it will save everything inside of the volume those Corner Blocks make.
translation: Pressin' the Detect button in Save mode will find all o' the Corner Blocks with the same name and create a selection area so that it'll save everything inside o' the volume those Corner Blocks make.

source_string: Combine two Shulker Shells with a Chest to create a Shulker Box. Shulker Shells are dropped by Shulkers found in End Cities. Unlike other containers, Shulker Boxes keep their items when broken. Shulker Boxes will break and drop as an item if pushed by Pistons, and can be placed using Dispensers.
translation: Combine two Shulker Shells with a Chest to create a Shulker Box. Shulker Shells be dropped by Shulkers found in End Cities. Unlike other containers, Shulker Boxes keep their items when broken. Shulker Boxes will break and drop as an item if pushed by Pistons, and can be placed usin' Dispensers.

source_string: How to Play: The Crafting Table
translation: How to Play: The Craftin' Table

source_string: Ready to take your crafting to the next level? Place four planks in a square in your crafting grid, and you'll get a §ecrafting table§f :crafting_table: - a whole new way to craft.
translation: Ready to take yer craftin' to the next level? Place four planks in a square in yer craftin' grid, and ye'll get a §ecraftin' table§f :crafting_table: - a whole new way to craft.

source_string: Place your crafting table in the world, then right-click it to open it. The larger crafting grid will let you make bigger and better things, including tools, beds, and doors.
translation: Place yer craftin' table in the world, then right-click it to open it. The larger craftin' grid will let ye make bigger and better things, includin' tools, beds, and doors.

source_string: Place your crafting table in the world, then walk up to it and press :_input_key.use: to open it. The larger crafting grid will let you make bigger and better things, including tools, beds, and doors.
translation: Place yer craftin' table in the world, then walk up to it and press :_input_key.use: to open it. The larger craftin' grid will let ye make bigger and better things, includin' tools, beds, and doors.

source_string: Place your crafting table in the world, then tap it to open it. The larger crafting grid will let you make bigger and better things, including tools, beds, and doors.
translation: Place yer craftin' table in the world, then tap it to open it. The larger craftin' grid will let ye make bigger and better things, includin' tools, beds, and doors.

source_string: The End is another dimension which can be accessed through an active End Portal. The End Portal can be found in a Stronghold, which is deep underground in the Overworld.
translation: The End be another dimension which can be accessed through an active End Portal. The End Portal can be found in a Stronghold, which be deep underground in the Overworld.

source_string: Every End Portal Frame block is missing something mysterious to bring out the power within.
translation: Every End Portal Frame block be missin' somethin' mysterious to bring out the power within.

source_string: Once the portal is active, jump into it to go to The End.
translation: Once the portal be active, jump into it to go to The End.

source_string: The End is home to the dreaded Ender Dragon. She is a fierce and powerful enemy and seems to draw power from strange crystals. Her breath and fireball attacks leave lingering acid across the battlefield. Bring some friends to ensure your victory!
translation: The End be home to the dreaded Ender Dragon. She be a fierce and powerful enemy and seems to draw power from strange crystals. Her breath and fireball attacks leave lingerin' acid across the battlefield. Bring some mateys to ensure yer victory!

source_string: If once wasn't enough, add four End Crystals to the exit portal corners to reawaken the Ender Dragon.
translation: If once wasn't enough, add four End Crystals to the exit portal corners to reawaken the Ender Dragon.

source_string: Texture packs visually transform the game's appearance, applying a fresh coat of paint to your Minecraft world.
translation: Texture packs visually transform the game's appearance, applyin' a fresh coat o' paint to yer Minecraft world.

source_string: There are many tools in Minecraft that will allow you mine blocks faster than your fist. Tools can be crafted from Wood, Stone, Iron, Gold, Diamond, or Netherite.
translation: There be many tools in Minecraft that will allow ye mine blocks faster than yer fist. Tools can be crafted from Wood, Stone, Iron, Gold, Diamond, or Netherite.

source_string: Using the right tool for the job will not only mine that block faster, but will also lose less durability. More complex tools must be created in order to mine rarer resources.
translation: Usin' the right tool fer the job will not only mine that block faster, but will also lose less durability. More complex tools must be created in order to mine rarer resources.

source_string: The Pickaxe is good at breaking hard blocks like Cobblestone, Iron, or Furnaces.
translation: The Pickaxe be good at breakin' hard blocks like Cobblestone, Iron, or Furnaces.

source_string: The Axe is good at breaking wooden blocks like Logs, Planks, or Crafting Tables.
translation: The Axe be good at breakin' wooden blocks like Logs, Planks, or Craftin' Tables.

source_string: The Shovel is good at breaking loose blocks like Dirt, Sand, and Gravel. Shovels can also create a path by pressing :_input_key.use: on grass blocks.
translation: The Shovel be good at breakin' loose blocks like Dirt, Sand, and Gravel. Shovels can also create a path by pressin' :_input_key.use: on grass blocks.

source_string: The Shovel is good at breaking loose blocks like Dirt, Sand, and Gravel. Shovels can also create a path by tapping on grass blocks.
translation: The Shovel be good at breakin' loose blocks like Dirt, Sand, and Gravel. Shovels can also create a path by tappin' on grass blocks.

source_string: The Hoe is required for tilling Dirt to plant crops. Press :_input_key.use: on Dirt or Grass blocks to turn them into Farmland.
translation: The Hoe be required fer tillin' Dirt to plant crops. Press :_input_key.use: on Dirt or Grass blocks to turn 'em into Farmland.

source_string: The Hoe is required for tilling Dirt to plant crops. Tap Dirt or Grass blocks to turn them into Farmland.
translation: The Hoe be required fer tillin' Dirt to plant crops. Tap Dirt or Grass blocks to turn 'em into Farmland.

source_string: All of these tools can accept enchantments, either from the Enchanting Table or Anvil.
translation: All o' these tools can accept enchantments, either from the Enchantin' Table or Anvil.

source_string: There are even more tools to aid you on your adventure:
translation: There be even more tools to aid ye on yer adventure:

source_string: A Bucket will allow you to collect things like Water, Milk, Lava, and even Fish.
translation: A Bucket will allow ye to collect things like Water, Milk, Lava, and even Fish.

source_string: Flint & Steel allows you to light fires... be careful in densely wooded areas!
translation: Flint & Steel allows ye to light fires... be careful in densely wooded areas!

source_string: A Fishing Rod lets you catch fish and other loot from water blocks. It can also be used to pull other players and mobs. Fishing Rods can also be enchanted!
translation: A Fishin' Rod lets ye catch fish and other loot from water blocks. It can also be used to pull other players and mobs. Fishin' Rods can also be enchanted!

source_string: Shears are very handy for collecting items like Wool, Leaves, and Cobwebs.
translation: Shears be very handy fer collectin' items like Wool, Leaves, and Cobwebs.

source_string: Trading can be done in villages. Each villager has a profession; they can be Farmers, Butchers, Blacksmiths, Cartographers, Librarians, or Priests. Some professions will trade for items that other professions cannot. Explore and trade with many villagers to find all the trades.
translation: Tradin' can be done in villages. Each villager has a profession; they can be Farmers, Butchers, Blacksmiths, Cartographers, Librarians, or Priests. Some professions will trade fer items that other professions can't. Explore and trade with many villagers to find all the trades.

source_string: You can find out what a villager is offering as trade by interacting with them. A villager may adjust the price of a trade whenever a player trades with it. A villager may run out of stock, temporarily disabling the trade if it is used too frequently. Trades usually involve buying or selling items for emeralds.
translation: Ye can find out what a villager be offerin' as trade by interactin' with 'em. A villager may adjust the price o' a trade whenever a player trades with it. A villager may run out o' stock, temporarily disablin' the trade if it be used too frequently. Trades usually involve buyin' or sellin' items fer emeralds.

source_string: As you trade with villagers, they will get better at their profession and start to offer better and more valuable trades.
translation: As ye trade with villagers, they'll get better at their profession and start to offer better and more valuable trades.

source_string: Take care of your villagers, they need to rest, work, and eat to thrive.
translation: Take care o' yer villagers, they need to rest, work, and eat to thrive.

source_string: There are many ways to get around other than walking or riding a mount or flying.
translation: There be many ways to get around other than walkin' or ridin' a mount or flyin'.

source_string: Minecarts are ridable carts that roll on Rails. You can make the Rails go wherever you want by placing them next to each other. Place a Minecart on the Rails and you are ready to ride.
translation: Minecarts be ridable carts that roll on Rails. Ye can make the Rails go wherever ye want by placin' 'em next to each other. Place a Minecart on the Rails and ye be ready to ride.

source_string: Minecarts are ridable carts that roll on Rails, which you can build to go anywhere. Just place multiple Rails next to each other, place a Minecart on it, and you're ready to ride.
translation: Minecarts be ridable carts that roll on Rails, which ye can build to go anywhere. Just place multiple Rails next to each other, place a Minecart on it, and ye're ready to ride.

source_string: Press :_input_key.use: while looking at a Minecart to hop in and ride. Press :_input_key.forward: to roll forward. Press :_input_key.jump: or :_input_key.sneak: to get out.
translation: Press :_input_key.use: while lookin' at a Minecart to hop in and ride. Press :_input_key.forward: to roll forward. Press :_input_key.jump: or :_input_key.sneak: to get out.

source_string: Press :_input_key.use: while looking at a Minecart to hop in and ride. Push :_gamepad_stick_left: forward to roll forward. Press :_input_key.jump: or :_input_key.sneak: to get out.
translation: Press :_input_key.use: while lookin' at a Minecart to hop in and ride. Push :_gamepad_stick_left: forward to roll forward. Press :_input_key.jump: or :_input_key.sneak: to get out.

source_string: Look at a Minecart and tap "Ride" to hop in.
translation: Look at a Minecart and tap "Ride" to hop in.

source_string: When using the D-Pad control scheme, tap and hold :touch_forward: to start moving forward and build momentum, and tap :touch_jump: to get out.
translation: When usin' the D-Pad control scheme, tap and hold :touch_forward: to start movin' forward and build momentum, and tap :touch_jump: to get out.

source_string: When using a Joystick control scheme, drag :tip_virtual_joystick: up to start moving forward and build momentum, and tap :tip_virtual_button_dismount: to get out.
translation: When usin' a Joystick control scheme, drag :tip_virtual_joystick: up to start movin' forward and build momentum, and tap :tip_virtual_button_dismount: to get out.

source_string: Boats let you travel across water. Place one on a water block and you are ready to go.
translation: Boats let ye travel across water. Place one on a water block and ye be ready to go.

source_string: Boats let you travel across water. Just place one on a water block and you're ready to go.
translation: Boats let ye travel across water. Just place one on a water block and ye're ready to go.

source_string: Press :_input_key.use: while looking at a Boat to board it. Press :_input_key.left: or :_input_key.right: to turn left or right. Press :_input_key.forward: to move forward. Press :_input_key.jump: or :_input_key.sneak: to get out.
translation: Press :_input_key.use: while lookin' at a Boat to board it. Press :_input_key.left: or :_input_key.right: to turn left or right. Press :_input_key.forward: to move forward. Press :_input_key.jump: or :_input_key.sneak: to get out.

source_string: Press :_input_key.use: while looking at a Boat to board it. Push :_gamepad_stick_left: left or right to turn. Push :_gamepad_stick_left: forward to move forward. Press :_input_key.jump: or :_input_key.sneak: to get out.
translation: Press :_input_key.use: while lookin' at a Boat to board it. Push :_gamepad_stick_left: left or right to turn. Push :_gamepad_stick_left: forward to move forward. Press :_input_key.jump: or :_input_key.sneak: to get out.

source_string: Look at a Boat and tap "Board" to board it.
translation: Look at a Boat and tap "Board" to board it.

source_string: When using the D-Pad control scheme, tap :touch_left: or :touch_right: to turn left or right, or tap and hold both to move forward. Tap "Leave Boat" to get out.
translation: When usin' the D-Pad control scheme, tap :touch_left: or :touch_right: to turn left or right, or tap and hold both to move forward. Tap "Leave Boat" to get out.

source_string: When using a Joystick control scheme, drag :tip_virtual_joystick: up to move forward and tap :tip_virtual_button_dismount: to get out.
translation: When usin' a Joystick control scheme, drag :tip_virtual_joystick: up to move forward and tap :tip_virtual_button_dismount: to get out.

source_string: The Sword is the primary melee weapon in Minecraft. It can be made from Wood, Stone, Iron, Gold, Diamond, or Netherite. Jump attacks do critical damage!
translation: The Sword be the primary melee weapon in Minecraft. It can be made from Wood, Stone, Iron, Gold, Diamond, or Netherite. Jump attacks do critical damage!

source_string: Press :_input_key.attack: with a Sword in your hand to attack.
translation: Press :_input_key.attack: with a Sword in yer hand to attack.

source_string: The Bow is the primary ranged weapon in Minecraft. Press and hold :_input_key.use: to draw the bow back. Release :_input_key.use: to fire an arrow. The bow requires arrows to fire.
translation: The Bow be the primary ranged weapon in Minecraft. Press and hold :_input_key.use: to draw the bow back. Release :_input_key.use: to fire an arrow. The bow requires arrows to fire.

source_string: The Bow is the primary ranged weapon in Minecraft. Press and hold the Screen to draw the bow back. Release the press to fire an arrow. The bow requires arrows to fire.
translation: The Bow be the primary ranged weapon in Minecraft. Press and hold the Screen to draw the bow back. Release the press to fire an arrow. The bow requires arrows to fire.

source_string: Bows do more damage the further they are pulled back, make sure to pull it all the way back.
translation: Bows do more damage the further they be pulled back, make sure to pull it all the way back.

source_string: The Crossbow is an alternate ranged weapon. Press and hold :_input_key.use: to load the crossbow. Once the Crossbow is loaded, it will stay loaded until it is fired. Press :_input_key.use: to fire an arrow. The Crossbow requires arrows to load.
translation: Th' Crossbow be an alternate ranged weapon. Press and hold :_input_key.use: to load 'er up. Once she be loaded, she'll stay loaded 'til she be fired. Press :_input_key.use: to fire an arrow. Th' Crossbow needs arrows to load.

source_string: The crossbow is a ranged weapon which requires an arrow to be loaded. Tap and hold anywhere on the screen to load the crossbow with an arrow.
translation: Th' crossbow be a long-range weapon what needs an arrow loaded into 'er. Tap and hold anywhere on th' screen to load 'er with an arrow.

source_string: Once you've loaded the crossbow it'll stay loaded until fired, even when you put it in your inventory.
translation: Once ye've loaded th' crossbow she'll stay loaded 'til fired, even when ye stow 'er in yer inventory.

source_string: Tap anywhere on the screen to fire a loaded crossbow.
translation: Tap anywhere on th' screen to fire a loaded crossbow.

source_string: If you're using Action Buttons, tap :tip_virtual_button_action_build_or_use: to fire a loaded crossbow.
translation: If ye be usin' Action Buttons, tap :tip_virtual_button_action_build_or_use: to fire a loaded crossbow.

source_string: The Trident is a dual-purpose melee and ranged weapon. Press :_input_key.attack: to attack. Press and hold :_input_key.use: to draw the trident back. Release :_input_key.use: to throw the trident. The Trident is the best weapon underwater.
translation: Th' Trident be a dual-purpose weapon, good fer melee and long-range. Press :_input_key.attack: to attack. Press and hold :_input_key.use: to draw th' trident back. Release :_input_key.use: to hurl th' trident. Th' Trident be th' best weapon underwater, arrr.

source_string: The Trident is a dual-purpose melee and ranged weapon. Tap mobs to attack them. Press and hold the Screen to draw the trident back. Release the press to throw the trident. The Trident is the best weapon underwater.
translation: Th' Trident be a dual-purpose weapon, good fer melee and long-range. Tap mobs to attack 'em. Press and hold th' Screen to draw th' trident back. Release th' press to hurl th' trident. Th' Trident be th' best weapon underwater, arrr.

source_string: The Sword, Bow, Crossbow, and Trident have specific enchantments that you can get from the Enchanting Table or Anvil that will improve damage, durability and even light mobs on fire!
translation: Th' Sword, Bow, Crossbow, and Trident have special Enchantments ye can get from th' Enchantin' Table or Anvil that'll boost damage, durability, and even set mobs ablaze!

source_string: Worlds in the Minecraft Marketplace Minecraft levels where our partners have altered the terrain and placed new blocks to create amazing structures and terrain for you to explore and enjoy.
translation: Worlds in th' Minecraft Marketplace be Minecraft levels where our partners have reshaped th' terrain and set down new blocks to craft amazin' structures and lands fer ye to explore and enjoy.

source_string: Worlds can also include new items, mobs, blocks and even custom gameplay.
translation: Worlds can also stow away new items, mobs, blocks, an' even custom gameplay.

source_string: All of the content in the Marketplace is created by our professional commiunity creators.
translation: All the goods in the Marketplace be crafted by our professional community creators.

source_string: Worlds can do so much, we've created several Sub-Categories to help describe what they can do:
translation: Worlds can do so much, we've split 'em into several Sub-Categories to help tell ye what they can do:

source_string: Mini-Games are smaller worlds that include new game mechanics, challenges, or rules.
translation: Mini-Games be smaller worlds that bring new game mechanics, challenges, or rules.

source_string: These games are made with multiplayer in mind, letting you test your skills and have fun with your friends.
translation: These games be made with multiplayer in mind, lettin' ye test yer skills an' have fun with yer mateys.

source_string: Survival Spawns let you start playing in a custom-built world, while still enjoying the classic survival mechanics of Minecraft.
translation: Survival Spawns let ye start playin' in a custom-built world, while still enjoyin' the classic survival mechanics o' Minecraft.

source_string: Just like in Survival mode you will have health and hunger, and need to fight dangerous mobs.
translation: Just like in Survival mode ye'll have health an' hunger, an' need to fight dangerous mobs.

source_string: Adventure Maps let you use Minecraft to play a totally different kind of game.
translation: Adventure Maps let ye use Minecraft to play a whole different kind o' game.

source_string: You can not break blocks or place new blocks in these worlds.
translation: Ye can't break blocks or place new blocks in these worlds.

source_string: Dynamic Worlds allow you to explore the creative designs of our marketplace creators in a randomly generated map.
translation: Dynamic Worlds let ye explore the creative designs o' our marketplace creators in a randomly generated map.

source_string: Worlds can have new biomes, customized structures (randomly generated buildings), new blocks, textures, and mobs.
translation: Worlds can have new biomes, customized structures (randomly generated buildings), new blocks, textures, an' mobs.

source_string: How to Play: Your First Craft
translation: How to Play: Yer First Craft

source_string: Many blocks, like wood, can be turned into useful items by crafting. To do this, you'll find a simple §ecrafting grid§f on the right-hand side of your inventory screen.
translation: Many blocks, like wood, can be turned into useful items by craftin'. To do this, ye'll find a simple §ecraftin' grid§f on the right-hand side o' yer inventory screen.

source_string: For example, put a single wood log anywhere on the crafting grid, and several planks will appear in the §eoutput slot§f.
translation: For example, put a single wood log anywhere on the craftin' grid, an' several planks will appear in the §eoutput slot§f.

source_string: Simply tap your shiny new planks and they will appear in your hotbar. Now you're ready to place them into the world!
translation: Simply tap yer shiny new planks an' they'll appear in yer hotbar. Now yer ready to place 'em into the world!

source_string: Simply drag your shiny new planks to your hotbar. Now you're ready to place them into the world!
translation: Simply drag yer shiny new planks to yer hotbar. Now yer ready to place 'em into the world!

source_string: Simply select your shiny new planks and they will appear in your hotbar. Now you're ready to place them into the world!
translation: Simply select yer shiny new planks an' they'll appear in yer hotbar. Now yer ready to place 'em into the world!

source_string: Some items require you to place your crafting ingredients in a certain shape - also called a §erecipe§f.
translation: Some items need ye to place yer craftin' ingredients in a certain shape - also called a §erecipe§f.

source_string: Try placing two planks above each other to create some sticks. Useful for all sorts of things!
translation: Try placin' two planks above each other to make some sticks. Handy fer all sorts o' things!

translation: There be a problem connectin' to Immersive Reader.

source_string: Use the Library to find new game worlds to build in.

source_string: In Survival Mode, players must find their own resources.
translation: In Survival Mode, players must find their own resources.

translation: In Creative Mode, players can freely choose to build from any o' the blocks in Minecraft.

translation: Yer code buildin' robot helper be called the Agent.

source_string: Redstone can be used in Minecraft to create circuits and simple machines.
translation: Redstone can be used in Minecraft to create circuits and simple machines.

source_string: Use "/spawnpoint" to change your spawn point. It's just like you slept in a bed!

source_string: Most monsters only come out at night. During the day you're safe... probably.
translation: Most monsters only come out at night. Durin' the day ye be safe... probably.

translation: Break blocks, pick up resources. Use the craftin' grid to make helpful items. Now ye be craftin'!

translation: Ye have endless lives, but yer items drop to the ground when ye die. Hurry back to pick 'em up!

source_string: It's a good idea to build a place where you can safely spend the night.
translation: It's a good idea to build a place where ye can safely spend the night.

source_string: Use the right tool for the job! Chopping wood with an axe is much faster than using your hands.
translation: Use the right tool fer the job! Choppin' wood with an axe be much faster than usin' yer hands.

translation: Even in Minecraft ye'll get hungry, so try to find somethin' to eat before that happens.

source_string: Digging straight down or straight up might not be a great idea.
translation: Diggin' straight down or straight up might not be a great idea.

translation: Monsters spawn in the dark. Craft a torch to brighten up any space.

source_string: Beds are great! Craft one to quickly pass the night and set your respawn point.
translation: Beds be great! Craft one to quickly pass the night and set yer respawn point.

source_string: Be careful when you swim. Stay under water for too long and you'll run out of air.
translation: Be careful when ye swim. Stay under water fer too long and ye'll run out o' air.

source_string: Survival mode has 4 different difficulty levels - Peaceful, Easy, Normal, and Hard. Or play Creative mode and get endless resources!
translation: Survival mode has 4 different difficulty levels - Peaceful, Easy, Normal, and Hard. Or play Creative mode and get endless resources!

source_string: Iron golems will fight for you!
translation: Iron golems will fight fer ye!

translation: Feed a bone to a wolf to tame it. Ye can then make it sit or follow ye.

source_string: Wearing a pumpkin on your head will keep Endermen from attacking you.
translation: Wearin' a pumpkin on yer head will keep Endermen from attackin' ye.

source_string: Harvest leather from cows, and use it to make armor and books.
translation: Harvest leather from cows, and use it to make armor and books.

translation: Ye can fill an empty bucket with water, lava, milk, powdered snow... and even some mobs.

translation: Feedin' an animal will keep it from despawnin'. Build a pen to keep yer animals safe.

translation: Get to yer destination faster with a minecart and some rails!

translation: Buildin' a portal will allow ye to travel to another dimension called the Nether.

translation: Bonemeal (crafted from a skeleton bone) can be used as a fertilizer and can make things grow instantly!

translation: Obsidian be created when water hits a lava source block.

translation: Take caution when buildin' structures made o' wool out in the open, as lightnin' from thunderstorms can set wool on fire.

translation: A single bucket o' lava can be used in a furnace to smelt 100 blocks.

translation: The instrument played by a note block depends on the material beneath it.

translation: Attackin' a wolf will cause any wolves nearby to turn hostile and attack ye.

translation: Before ye mine diamonds, redstone, or gold, make sure ye be usin' an iron or diamond pickaxe or it won't work.

translation: Placin' two chests side by side will make one large chest.

translation: Can't find any coal fer yer torches? Try puttin' some logs in a furnace.

translation: Plant some saplings and they'll grow into trees.

translation: Use a hoe to prepare areas o' ground fer plantin'.

translation: Zombified piglins won't attack ye - unless ye make 'em angry.

translation: Hit those fireballs back at the Ghast!

translation: Our music be by C418, Lena Raine, Aaron Cherof, and Kumi Tanioka.

translation: There'll be an update to this game eventually!

translation: The first version o' Minecraft was created in just 6 days!

translation: The Enderman language be actually English in reverse.

translation: A Spider Jockey be the rare appearance o' a spider bein' ridden by a skeleton!

translation: Travelin' one block in the Nether be equal to travelin' eight blocks in the Overworld.

translation: Elytra can be used to glide, find 'em in End city ships!

translation: Monsters that be killed by skeletons arrows have a chance o' droppin' music discs.

translation: Usin' firework rockets boosts elytra speed in mid air. Just... make sure they don't explode, otherwise it'll hurt BADLY!
