source_string: Summon mobs in an instant with spawn eggs.
translation: Summon mobs in an instant with spawn eggs.
context: Players can use an item called Sawn Egg to summon animals and monsters.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Collect goat horns and fill the world with music.
translation: Collect goat horns and fill the world with music.
context: Goat horn is an object players can use to play loud sounds.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Combine flint and steel with a TNT block for explosive results.
translation: Combine flint and steel with a TNT block fer explosive results.
context: Flint and steel is a tool used to create fire or to ignite certain blocks, structures and mobs. TNT will explode when you light it.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Try blinking around the map with an ender pearl. Don't get dizzy!
translation: Try blinkin' around the map with an ender pearl. Don't get dizzy!
context: An ender pearl is an item that can be thrown and teleports the thrower to where it lands.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Use rails and a minecart to build the perfect transport system. Or rollercoaster!
translation: Use rails and a minecart to build the perfect transport system. Or rollercoaster!
context: To  encourage players to build railroads{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Seeking a little more danger? Survival mode has plenty.
translation: Seekin' a little more danger? Survival mode has plenty.
context: In the Game mode Survival mode you can die. In Creative you can’t.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Crossbows need ammo. Add some arrows to your inventory before going hunting.
translation: Crossbows need ammo. Add some arrows to yer inventory before goin' huntin'.
context: Crossbows need ammo. Add some arrows to your inventory before going hunting.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: You can't die, but villagers can. Use that information... wisely.
translation: Ye can't die, but villagers can. Use that information... wisely.
context: This means you can do things that will get villagers killed. Like attracting monsters to the village.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Villagers are great at building villages. Think you can do better?
translation: Villagers be great at buildin' villages. Think ye can do better?
context: This is a prompt to encourage players to build things.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Wolves will attack skeletons to chew on their tasty bones.
translation: Wolves will attack skeletons to chew on their tasty bones.
context: Wolves will attack skeletons. It’s also a discrete hint that you should feel wolves with bones to tame them.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Tame wild horses by sitting on them until they're calm, then saddle up and ride off. (Note: Horses do not work like that outside of Minecraft.)
translation: Tame wild horses by sittin' on 'em until they're calm, then saddle up and ride off. (Note: Horses do not work like that outside o' Minecraft.)
context: It’s a bit unintuitive how you tame horses. Most other animals are tamed by feeding them. Not Horses. {MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Eat as much as you want, you'll never get full! And you'll never starve.
translation: Eat as much as ye want, ye'll never get full! And ye'll never starve.
context: In Creative Mode you don’t get hungry. Eating the food it just for fun.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Move through solid objects using spectator mode.
translation: Move through solid objects usin' spectator mode.
context: There is a Game mode called Spectator Mode. It allows you to fly through walls and blocks and everything.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Who needs tools? Punch your way to success and remove blocks instantly in creative mode.
translation: Who needs tools? Punch yer way to success and remove blocks instantly in creative mode.
context: Block breaking happens very fast when you’re in Creative Mode.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Like what you see? Use the pick block button to start building with whatever you're looking at. Yes, even mobs!
translation: Like what ye see? Use the pick block button to start buildin' with whatever ye're lookin' at. Aye, even mobs!
context: There is a feature called “Pick block” that enables players to instantly equip any block they click on. If you click on a mob(animal or monster) you will get a spawn egg that summons another monster/animal of that kind.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Get there now with the /tp command.
translation: Get there now with the /tp command.
context: You can teleport yourself in Creative. You use the /tp command in the chat.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Mobs won't notice you in creative mode, but they'll still notice each other…
translation: Mobs won't notice ye in creative mode, but they'll still notice each other…
context: Mobs(animals & monsters) won’t notice you in creative mode, but they’ll still notice each other… meaning that they can still kill each other.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: A warden a day keeps the… well, everything away.
translation: A warden a day keeps the… well, everythin' away.
context: The Warden is a scary monster that live in underground cities.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Why not build an underwater base? It's not like you can drown.
translation: Why not build an underwater base? It's not like ye can drown.
context: You can’t drown in creative mode. So it’s possible to build underwater without danger.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Whatever you can dream, you can build. There's no limit to your resources (in creative mode...).
translation: Whatever ye can dream, ye can build. There's no limit to yer resources (in creative mode...).
context: Players have endless resources in Creative mode. They get all the building blocks from their inventory.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Phantoms can't hurt you, but you can still shoo them off by using a bed. Just...not literally. You sleep in it.
translation: Phantoms can't hurt ye, but ye can still shoo 'em off by usin' a bed. Just...not literally. Ye sleep in it.
context: Phantoms are flying mobs(monsters) that spawn when you havn't slept for a few days. They won't hurt you in Creative Mode. To get rid of them you sleep in a bed.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Have you tried swimming in lava? It's like sinking into a warm bath. Just don't try it in survival mode...
translation: Have ye tried swimmin' in lava? It's like sinkin' into a warm bath. Just don't try it in survival mode...
context: Lava doesn't hurt you in creative mode.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Push :windowsmr_left_stick: forward twice in rapid succession to sprint. While you hold :windowsmr_left_stick: forward, you will continue to sprint until you have less than :shank::shank::shank:.
translation: Push :windowsmr_left_stick: forward twice in rapid succession to sprint. While ye hold :windowsmr_left_stick: forward, ye will continue to sprint until ye have less than :shank::shank::shank:.

source_string: Hold :_input_key.attack: to mine and chop using your hand or whatever you are holding. You may need to craft a tool to mine some blocks.
translation: Hold :_input_key.attack: to mine an' chop usin' yer hand or whatever ye be holdin'. Ye may need to craft a tool to mine some blocks.

source_string: Touch and hold the screen on a block to mine and chop using your hand or whatever you are holding. You may need to craft a tool to mine some blocks.
translation: Touch an' hold the screen on a block to mine an' chop usin' yer hand or whatever ye be holdin'. Ye may need to craft a tool to mine some blocks.

source_string: If you are holding an item in your hand, use :_input_key.use: to use that item or press :_input_key.drop: to drop it.
translation: If ye be holdin' an item in yer hand, use :_input_key.use: to use that item or press :_input_key.drop: to drop it.

source_string: If you are holding an item in your hand, use :_input_key.use: to use that item or press :_input_key.drop: to drop it.
translation: If ye be holdin' an item in yer hand, use :_input_key.use: to use that item or press :_input_key.drop: to drop it.

source_string: If you are holding an item in your hand, use :rift_right_grab: to use that item or press :rift_right_stick: to drop it.
translation: If ye be holdin' an item in yer hand, use :rift_right_grab: to use that item or press :rift_right_stick: to drop it.

source_string: If you are holding an item in your hand, use :windowsmr_left_trigger: to use that item or press :windowsmr_right_grab: to drop it.
translation: If ye be holdin' an item in yer hand, use :windowsmr_left_trigger: to use that item or press :windowsmr_right_grab: to drop it.

source_string: If you are holding an item in your hand, touch the screen to use that item or touch and hold the item in your hotbar to drop it.
translation: If ye be holdin' an item in yer hand, touch the screen to use that item or touch an' hold the item in yer hotbar to drop it.

source_string: Sneaking is incredibly useful in Minecraft, sneaking keeps you from falling off of a block and hides your nametag. To sneak, hold :_input_key.sneak:.
translation: Sneakin' be incredibly useful in Minecraft, sneakin' keeps ye from fallin' off o' a block an' hides yer nametag. To sneak, hold :_input_key.sneak:.

source_string: Sneaking is incredibly useful in Minecraft, sneaking keeps you from falling off of a block and hides your nametag. To toggle sneak, press :_input_key.sneak: or click :_gamepad_stick_right:.
translation: Sneakin' be incredibly useful in Minecraft, sneakin' keeps ye from fallin' off o' a block an' hides yer nametag. To toggle sneak, press :_input_key.sneak: or click :_gamepad_stick_right:.

source_string: Sneaking is incredibly useful in Minecraft, sneaking keeps you from falling off of a block and hides your nametag. To toggle sneak, tap :touch_sneak:.
translation: Sneakin' be incredibly useful in Minecraft, sneakin' keeps ye from fallin' off o' a block an' hides yer nametag. To toggle sneak, tap :touch_sneak:.

source_string: Sneaking is incredibly useful in Minecraft, sneaking keeps you from falling off of a block and hides your nametag. To toggle sneak, press :rift_X:.
translation: Sneakin' be incredibly useful in Minecraft, sneakin' keeps ye from fallin' off o' a block an' hides yer nametag. To toggle sneak, press :rift_X:.

source_string: Sneaking is incredibly useful in Minecraft, sneaking keeps you from falling off of a block and hides your nametag. To toggle sneak, press :windowsmr_right_stick:.
translation: Sneakin' be incredibly useful in Minecraft, sneakin' keeps ye from fallin' off o' a block an' hides yer nametag. To toggle sneak, press :windowsmr_right_stick:.

source_string: Sprinting while in water will make you swim. Use the mouse to control the direction that you are swimming.
translation: Sprintin' while in water will make ye swim. Use the mouse to control the direction that ye be swimmin'.

source_string: Sprinting while in water will make you swim. Use the :_gamepad_stick_right: to control the direction that you are swimming.
translation: Sprintin' while in water will make ye swim. Use the :_gamepad_stick_right: to control the direction that ye be swimmin'.

source_string: Sprinting while in water will make you swim. Touch and drag along the screen to control the direction that you are swimming.
translation: Sprintin' while in water will make ye swim. Touch an' drag along the screen to control the direction that ye be swimmin'.

source_string: Sprinting while in water will make you swim. Use the :rift_right_stick: to control the direction that you are swimming.
translation: Sprintin' while in water will make ye swim. Use the :rift_right_stick: to control the direction that ye be swimmin'.

source_string: Sprinting while in water will make you swim. Use the :windowsmr_right_stick: to control the direction that you are swimming.
translation: Sprintin' while in water will make ye swim. Use the :windowsmr_right_stick: to control the direction that ye be swimmin'.

source_string: Press :_input_key.inventory: to access the Recipe Book and Crafting Grid.
translation: Press :_input_key.inventory: to access the Recipe Book an' Craftin' Grid.

source_string: Press :_input_container.crafting: to access the Recipe Book and Crafting Grid.
translation: Press :_input_container.crafting: to access the Recipe Book an' Craftin' Grid.

source_string: Tap the Inventory Button to access the Recipe Book and Crafting Grid.
translation: Tap the Inventory Button to access the Recipe Book an' Craftin' Grid.

source_string: Press :rift_B: to access the Recipe Book and Crafting Grid.
translation: Press :rift_B: to access the Recipe Book an' Craftin' Grid.

source_string: Press :windowsmr_left_grab: to access the Recipe Book and Crafting Grid.
translation: Press :windowsmr_left_grab: to access the Recipe Book an' Craftin' Grid.

source_string: Arrange items from your Inventory or Hotbar in the crafting grid in the shape of an item recipe.
translation: Arrange items from yer Inventory or Hotbar in the craftin' grid in the shape o' an item recipe.

source_string: If the recipe is correct the item you are attempting to craft will appear in the Output Slot to the right of the Crafting Grid. Take it from the Output Slot and put it in your Inventory. You can now use the item.
translation: If the recipe be correct the item ye be attemptin' to craft will appear in the Output Slot to the right o' the Craftin' Grid. Take it from the Output Slot an' put it in yer Inventory. Ye can now use the item.

source_string: There are many recipes and for some you will need a larger Crafting Grid than the 2x2 grid that you start with.
translation: There be many recipes an' for some ye will need a larger Craftin' Grid than the 2x2 grid that ye start with.

source_string: Craft 4 Wooden Planks into a Crafting Table and place it in the world.
translation: Craft 4 Wooden Planks into a Craftin' Table an' place it in the world.

source_string: Press :_input_key.use: on a Crafting Table in the world to gain access to a 3x3 Crafting Grid.
translation: Press :_input_key.use: on a Craftin' Table in the world to gain access to a 3x3 Craftin' Grid.

source_string: Press :_input_key.use: on a Crafting Table in the world to gain access to a 3x3 Crafting Grid.
translation: Press :_input_key.use: on a Craftin' Table in the world to gain access to a 3x3 Craftin' Grid.

source_string: Press :rift_right_grab: on a Crafting Table in the world to gain access to a 3x3 Crafting Grid.
translation: Press :rift_right_grab: on a Craftin' Table in the world to gain access to a 3x3 Craftin' Grid.

source_string: Press :windowsmr_left_trigger: on a Crafting Table in the world to gain access to a 3x3 Crafting Grid.
translation: Press :windowsmr_left_trigger: on a Craftin' Table in the world to gain access to a 3x3 Craftin' Grid.

source_string: Tap on a Crafting Table in the world to gain access to a 3x3 Crafting Grid.
translation: Tap on a Craftin' Table in the world to gain access to a 3x3 Craftin' Grid.

source_string: On the left side of the screen you will see the Recipe Book, which is good if you don't know a recipe or want to quickly craft a recipe that you already know. You will also see the Crafting grid on the right side of the screen above your Inventory.
translation: On the left side o' the screen ye will see the Recipe Book, which be good if ye don't know a recipe or want to quickly craft a recipe that ye already know. Ye will also see the Craftin' grid on the right side o' the screen above yer Inventory.

source_string: Once you have found the recipe you want to craft, :_input_key.attack: the recipe to load it into the crafting grid, then take it from the Output Slot to the right of the Crafting Grid and put it in your Inventory. :_input_key.use: the recipe to auto-craft, this automatically crafts one set and puts it in your inventory. SHIFT + :_input_key.use: the recipe to auto-craft a whole stack.
translation: Once ye have found the recipe ye want to craft, :_input_key.attack: the recipe to load it into the craftin' grid, then take it from the Output Slot to the right o' the Craftin' Grid an' put it in yer Inventory. :_input_key.use: the recipe to auto-craft, this automatically crafts one set an' puts it in yer inventory. SHIFT + :_input_key.use: the recipe to auto-craft a whole stack.

source_string: Once you have found the recipe you want to craft, press :_gamepad_face_button_down: on the recipe to auto-craft, this automatically crafts one set and puts it in your inventory. Press :_gamepad_face_button_up: on the recipe to auto-craft a whole stack.
translation: Once ye have found the recipe ye want to craft, press :_gamepad_face_button_down: on the recipe to auto-craft, this automatically crafts one set an' puts it in yer inventory. Press :_gamepad_face_button_up: on the recipe to auto-craft a whole stack.

source_string: Once you have found the recipe you want to craft, tap the recipe to load it into the crafting grid, then tap the item in the output slot to craft it. Press and hold the item in the output slot to craft continuously.
translation: Once ye have found the recipe ye want to craft, tap the recipe to load it into the craftin' grid, then tap the item in the output slot to craft it. Press an' hold the item in the output slot to craft continuously.

source_string: When the :craftable_toggle_on: is on, the Recipe Book shows all of the recipes that you have ingredients for. When the :craftable_toggle_off: is off, the Recipe Book shows every recipe in the game, even if you can't craft it. Check the tabs or search if you are looking for something specific. In Creative Mode some recipes will be collapsed inside lists. Opening the list will expand it and show you all of the recipes inside.
translation: When the :craftable_toggle_on: be on, the Recipe Book shows all o' the recipes that ye have ingredients for. When the :craftable_toggle_off: be off, the Recipe Book shows every recipe in the game, even if ye can't craft it. Check the tabs or search if ye be lookin' for somethin' specific. In Creative Mode some recipes will be collapsed inside lists. Openin' the list will expand it an' show ye all o' the recipes inside.

source_string: To fly when in Creative Mode, Tap :_input_key.jump: twice quickly. To exit flying, repeat the action. To fly faster, tap :_input_key.forward: twice in rapid succession while flying. When in flying mode, you can press :touch_fly_up: to move up and :touch_fly_down: to move down.
translation: To fly when in Creative Mode, Tap :_input_key.jump: twice quickly. To exit flyin', repeat the action. To fly faster, tap :_input_key.forward: twice in rapid succession while flyin'. When in flyin' mode, ye can press :touch_fly_up: to move up an' :touch_fly_down: to move down.

source_string: How to Play : Eye Of Ender
translation: How to Play : Eye Of Ender

source_string: - Old worlds limited in size and height.
translation: - Old worlds limited in size an' height.

source_string: -Mob Loot: Controls whether mobs will drop loot when they die.
translation: -Mob Loot: Controls whether mobs will drop loot when they die.

source_string: -Mob Griefing: Prevents mobs from destroying the world.
translation: -Mob Griefin': Prevents mobs from destroyin' the world.

source_string: -Tile Drops: When this setting is turned on, blocks will drop themselves when they break.
translation: -Tile Drops: When this settin' be turned on, blocks will drop themselves when they break.

source_string: -Entities Drop Loot: Controls whether things like minecarts and armor stands will drop themselves when they are broken.
translation: -Entities Drop Loot: Controls whether things like minecarts an' armor stands will drop themselves when they be broken.

source_string: -Weather Cycle: The weather will not change when this setting is turned off.
translation: -Weather Cycle: The weather will not change when this settin' be turned off.

source_string: How to Play : Host and Player Options
translation: How to Play : Host an' Player Options

source_string: The HUD shows information about your status, your health, your remaining oxygen (when you are underwater), your hunger level, and your armor (if you are wearing any).
translation: The HUD shows information about yer status, yer health, yer remainin' oxygen (when ye be underwater), yer hunger level, an' yer armor (if ye be wearin' any).

source_string: If you lose some health but have at least nine :shank:, your health will replenish. Eating food will replenish your :shank:.
translation: If ye lose some health but have at least nine :shank:, yer health will replenish. Eatin' food will replenish yer :shank:.

source_string: Press and hold :_input_key.use: while holding a piece of food to eat it.
translation: Press an' hold :_input_key.use: while holdin' a piece o' food to eat it.

source_string: Press and hold :_input_key.use: while holding a piece of food to eat it.
translation: Press an' hold :_input_key.use: while holdin' a piece o' food to eat it.

source_string: Press and hold :rift_right_grab: while holding a piece of food to eat it.
translation: Press an' hold :rift_right_grab: while holdin' a piece o' food to eat it.

source_string: Press and hold :windowsmr_left_trigger: while holding a piece of food to eat it.
translation: Press an' hold :windowsmr_left_trigger: while holdin' a piece o' food to eat it.

source_string: Press and hold a piece of food to eat it.
translation: Press an' hold a piece o' food to eat it.

source_string: You must watch your hunger level while adventuring, your hunger level is represented on your HUD with :shank:. The hunger level decreases as you explore. Certain activities will decrease hunger level at a faster rate, such as sprinting. You can replenish your hunger level by eating food. Some foods are more nourishing than others and will fill up more :shank:. When you get your hunger level up to maximum, the last food you ate applies a saturation value. Saturation is a hidden number that gives you an extra bonus to your hunger level.
translation: Ye must watch yer hunger level while adventurin', yer hunger level be represented on yer HUD with :shank:. The hunger level decreases as ye explore. Certain activities will decrease hunger level at a faster rate, such as sprintin'. Ye can replenish yer hunger level by eatin' food. Some foods be more nourishin' than others an' will fill up more :shank:. When ye get yer hunger level up to maximum, the last food ye ate applies a saturation value. Saturation be a hidden number that gives ye an extra bonus to yer hunger level.

source_string: The Experience Bar is also shown on the HUD. The number shows your current Experience Level, and the bar indicates how many Experience Points are required to increase your Experience Level.
translation: The Experience Bar be also shown on the HUD. The number shows yer current Experience Level, an' the bar indicates how many Experience Points be required to increase yer Experience Level.

source_string: Experience Points are gained by collecting Experience Orbs. You can get Experience Orbs from activities such as killing mobs, mining certain blocks, and more! Don't leave any Experience Orbs behind, you're going to need them. Move near Experience Orbs to collect them.
translation: Experience Points be gained by collectin' Experience Orbs. Ye can get Experience Orbs from activities such as killin' mobs, minin' certain blocks, an' more! Don't leave any Experience Orbs behind, ye're goin' to need 'em. Move near Experience Orbs to collect 'em.

source_string: The hotbar shows the items that are available to use. Scroll the mouse wheel to change the item in your hand.
translation: The hotbar shows the items that be available to use. Scroll the mouse wheel to change the item in yer hand.

source_string: The hotbar shows the items that are available to use. Use :_input_key.cycleItemLeft: and :_input_key.cycleItemRight: to change the item in your hand.
translation: The hotbar shows the items that be available to use. Use :_input_key.cycleItemLeft: an' :_input_key.cycleItemRight: to change the item in yer hand.

source_string: The hotbar shows the items that are available to use. Tap items in your hotbar to change the item in your hand.
translation: The hotbar shows the items that be available to use. Tap items in yer hotbar to change the item in yer hand.

source_string: The hotbar shows the items that are available to use. Press :windowsmr_left_touchpad_horizontal: to change the item in your hand.
translation: The hotbar shows the items that be available to use. Press :windowsmr_left_touchpad_horizontal: to change the item in yer hand.

source_string: The hotbar shows the items that are available to use. Press :rift_left_trigger: or :rift_left_grab: to change the item in your hand.
translation: The hotbar shows the items that be available to use. Press :rift_left_trigger: or :rift_left_grab: to change the item in yer hand.

source_string: This screen shows the items that are available for use in your hand, and all of the other items that you are carrying. Your armor is also shown here.
translation: This screen shows the items that be available for use in yer hand, an' all o' the other items that ye be carryin'. Yer armor be also shown here.

source_string: Use :mouse_left_button: to pick up the item that is under the cursor. If there is more than one item here this will pick them all up, or you can use :mouse_right_button: to pick up just half of them.
translation: Use :mouse_left_button: to pick up the item that be under the cursor. If there be more than one item here this will pick 'em all up, or ye can use :mouse_right_button: to pick up just half o' 'em.

source_string: Use :_gamepad_face_button_down: to pick up the item that is under the cursor. If there is more than one item here this will pick them all up, or you can use :_gamepad_face_button_left: to pick up just half of them.
translation: Use :_gamepad_face_button_down: to pick up the item that be under the cursor. If there be more than one item here this will pick 'em all up, or ye can use :_gamepad_face_button_left: to pick up just half o' 'em.

source_string: Tap to select an item. If there is more than one item here this will select them all.
translation: Tap to select an item. If there be more than one item here this will select 'em all.

source_string: You can place items down again by using :mouse_left_button:. With multiple items on the cursor, use :mouse_left_button: to place them all or :mouse_right_button: to place just one.
translation: Ye can place items down again by usin' :mouse_left_button:. With multiple items on the cursor, use :mouse_left_button: to place 'em all or :mouse_right_button: to place just one.

source_string: You can place items down again by using :_gamepad_face_button_down:. With multiple items on the cursor, use :_gamepad_face_button_down: to place them all or :_gamepad_face_button_left: to place just one.
translation: Ye can place items down again by usin' :_gamepad_face_button_down:. With multiple items on the cursor, use :_gamepad_face_button_down: to place 'em all or :_gamepad_face_button_left: to place just one.

source_string: Tap another place in the inventory to move the item.
translation: Tap another place in the inventory to move the item.

source_string: If the item the cursor is over is armor, you can quick move it to the correct armor slot by pressing SHIFT+:mouse_left_button:.
translation: If the item the cursor be over be armor, ye can quick move it to the correct armor slot by pressin' SHIFT+:mouse_left_button:.

source_string: If the item the cursor is over is armor, you can quick move it to the correct armor slot by pressing :_gamepad_face_button_up:.
translation: If the item the cursor be over be armor, ye can quick move it to the correct armor slot by pressin' :_gamepad_face_button_up:.

source_string: To drop an item, pick up the item and put it down outside of the inventory window.
translation: To drop an item, pick up the item an' put it down outside o' the inventory window.

source_string: To drop an item, pick up the item and press :_gamepad_face_button_up:.
translation: To drop an item, pick up the item an' press :_gamepad_face_button_up:.

source_string: To drop an item, tap the item and then tap outside of the inventory window.
translation: To drop an item, tap the item an' then tap outside o' the inventory window.

source_string: Minecraft is a multiplayer game by default.
translation: Minecraft be a multiplayer game by default.

source_string: You can have local players join your game by connecting controllers and pressing any button on their controller at any point during the game.
translation: Ye can have local players join yer game by connectin' controllers an' pressin' any button on their controller at any point durin' the game.

source_string: By default, all worlds start with multiplayer enabled. If you would like to make the world private, go to world settings and select the multiplayer option, then toggle multiplayer off.
translation: By default, all worlds start with multiplayer enabled. If ye would like to make the world private, go to world settings an' select the multiplayer option, then toggle multiplayer off.

source_string: By default, all worlds start with multiplayer enabled. If you would like to make the world private, go to world settings and select the multiplayer option, then toggle multiplayer off.
translation: By default, all worlds start with multiplayer enabled. If ye would like to make the world private, go to world settings an' select the multiplayer option, then toggle multiplayer off.

source_string: To join a multiplayer game, go to the friends tab. All joinable Realms, Friends, and LAN Games will be shown here. Pick a game and select it to join.
translation: To join a multiplayer game, go to the friends tab. All joinable Realms, Friends, an' LAN Games will be shown here. Pick a game an' select it to join.

source_string: To join a multiplayer game, go to the friends tab. All joinable Realms, Friends, and LAN Games will be shown here. Pick a game and select it to join.
translation: To join a multiplayer game, go to the friends tab. All joinable Realms, Friends, an' LAN Games will be shown here. Pick a game an' select it to join.

source_string: When you start or join an online game, it will be visible to people in your friends tab. Once your friends join, the game will now be visible to friends of these friends.
translation: When ye start or join an online game, it will be visible to people in yer friends tab. Once yer friends join, the game will now be visible to friends o' these friends.

source_string: Note: You must have an internet connection and be signed into Xbox Live to play multiplayer.
translation: Note: Ye must have an internet connection an' be signed into Xbox Live to play multiplayer.

source_string: If you would like to manage the permissions of individual players, player permissions makes it easy. Open the pause menu and on the right, you will see a list of players currently in the world. Select their permission icon to adjust that player's permissions.
translation: If ye would like to manage the permissions o' individual players, player permissions makes it easy. Open the pause menu an' on the right, ye will see a list o' players currently in the world. Select their permission icon to adjust that player's permissions.

source_string: Realms is an awesome place to host a multiplayer game that is always running. Even when you aren't playing, your Realm will be up and running for your friends to explore!
translation: Realms be an awesome place to host a multiplayer game that be always runnin'. Even when ye aren't playin', yer Realm will be up an' runnin' for yer friends to explore!

source_string: To set up a Realm, select Create New from the Worlds tab. Then select the New Realm button, then the Create New World button. Here you can name your Realm, and set the number of players. Then you will be able to add friends to your Realm.
translation: To set up a Realm, select Create New from the Worlds tab. Then select the New Realm button, then the Create New World button. Here ye can name yer Realm, an' set the number o' players. Then ye will be able to add friends to yer Realm.

source_string: Once you have a Realm created, select the Pencil button to change the Realm settings.
translation: Once ye have a Realm created, select the Pencil button to change the Realm settings.

source_string: Under the Game button, you can rename the Realm, set the difficulty and gamemode, turn on cheats, and download/upload the world.
translation: Under the Game button, ye can rename the Realm, set the difficulty an' gamemode, turn on cheats, an' download/upload the world.

source_string: Under the Members button you can manage all of the friends you've invited to your Realm, add/remove members, and set their permissions.
translation: Under the Members button ye can manage all o' the friends ye've invited to yer Realm, add/remove members, an' set their permissions.

source_string: Under the Subscription button you can see when the Realm will expire, extend the time until expiration, and open/close the Realm.
translation: Under the Subscription button ye can see when the Realm will expire, extend the time until expiration, an' open/close the Realm.

source_string: How to Play : Resource And Behavior Packs
translation: How to Play : Resource An' Behavior Packs

source_string: You can change the way that Minecraft looks and behaves using Resource and Behavior Packs.
translation: Ye can change the way that Minecraft looks an' behaves usin' Resource an' Behavior Packs.

source_string: In the Settings Menu, choose a pack from the available packs list and select the plus sign next to it. Now your pack will apply its changes to the default Minecraft pack.
translation: In the Settings Menu, choose a pack from the available packs list an' select the plus sign next to it. Now yer pack will apply its changes to the default Minecraft pack.

source_string: The Server Tab will show popular Minecraft servers.
translation: The Server Tab will show popular Minecraft servers.

source_string: The Minecraft Marketplace is a place to find new skins, worlds, textures, and mash-up packs by various talented creators.
translation: The Minecraft Marketplace be a place to find new skins, worlds, textures, an' mash-up packs by various talented creators.

source_string: Try a new skin for a fresh new look!
translation: Try a new skin fer a fresh new look!

source_string: Check out worlds to unlock new maps and challenges that you will want to play again and again!
translation: Check out worlds to unlock new maps an' challenges that ye will want to play again an' again!

source_string: Give your old game a new look with texture packs that can be layered over your current worlds and Realms!
translation: Give yer old game a new look with texture packs that can be layered over yer current worlds an' Realms!

source_string: Give your old game a new look with texture packs that can be layered over your current worlds and Realms!
translation: Give yer old game a new look with texture packs that can be layered over yer current worlds an' Realms!

source_string: Or try them all with mash-up packs which are curated collections of skins, worlds, and textures that, when combined, will transform your worlds and Realms!
translation: Or try 'em all with mash-up packs which be curated collections o' skins, worlds, an' textures that, when combined, will transform yer worlds an' Realms!

source_string: Or try them all with mash-up packs which are curated collections of skins, worlds, and textures that, when combined, will transform your worlds and Realms!
translation: Or try 'em all with mash-up packs which be curated collections o' skins, worlds, an' textures that, when combined, will transform yer worlds an' Realms!

source_string: Tap the Ride button while near a Minecart to hop in and ride. Press :_input_key.forward: to roll forward. Tap :_input_key.jump: to get out.
translation: Tap the Ride button while near a Minecart to hop in an' ride. Press :_input_key.forward: to roll forward. Tap :_input_key.jump: to get out.

source_string: Tap the board button while near a Boat to board it. Press :_input_key.left: or :_input_key.right: to turn left or right. Press them both to move forward. Tap the leave boat button to get out.
translation: Tap the board button while near a Boat to board it. Press :_input_key.left: or :_input_key.right: to turn left or right. Press them both to move forward. Tap the leave boat button to get out.

source_string: The Sword, Bow, and Trident have specific enchantments that you can get from the Enchanting Table or Anvil that will improve damage, durability and even light mobs on fire!
translation: The Sword, Bow, an' Trident have specific enchantments that ye can get from the Enchantin' Table or Anvil that will improve damage, durability an' even light mobs on fire!

source_string: The Trident is a dual-purpose melee and ranged weapon. Press :_input_key.attack: to attack. Press and hold :_input_key.use: to draw the trident back. Release :_input_key.use: to throw the trident. The Trident is the best weapon underwater.
translation: The Trident be a dual-purpose melee an' ranged weapon. Press :_input_key.attack: to attack. Press an' hold :_input_key.use: to draw the trident back. Release :_input_key.use: to throw the trident. The Trident be the best weapon underwater.

translation: Oops! Yer model failed to upload to Remix3D.com.

translation: Somethin' went wrong. We weren't able to convert yer world. Ye can send us yer world later by goin' to yer old world an' pressin' Y. Or send us yer world now so we can investigate further.

source_string: Lost my items, creations, and/or player stats
translation: Lost me items, creations, an'/or player stats

translation: By hittin' Agree, ye be uploadin' yer world to the Minecraft Team. The Microsoft Services Agreement an' Privacy Statement apply.

translation: By uploadin' yer World ye hereby authorize Microsoft to test, reproduce, modify, distribute an' publicly display yer World in support o' transferrin' yer World to Minecraft.

source_string: Thank you! We are hard at work fixing things and won't be able to get back to you about this specific world. Here's your receipt confirming that we received it:
translation: Thank ye! We be hard at work fixin' things an' won't be able to get back to ye about this specific world. Here's yer receipt confirmin' that we received it:

translation: It appears ye don't have a license for Minecraft. Make sure ye have downloaded an' installed Minecraft from the store

source_string: When you see this icon, we are saving your game. Do not turn off your Nintendo Switch while this icon is on screen.
translation: When ye see this icon, we be savin' yer game. Do not turn off yer Nintendo Switch while this icon be on screen.

source_string: Xbox Live has arrived in Minecraft! It's a gaming community for phones, PCs, and Xbox. And the best part?
translation: Xbox Live has arrived in Minecraft! It's a gamin' community for phones, PCs, an' Xbox. An' the best part?

source_string: Don't have a Gamertag? Create one to earn achievements, play online with friends and join Realms!
translation: Don't have a Gamertag? Create one to earn achievements, play online with friends an' join Realms!

source_string: Don't have a Gamertag? Create one to earn achievements, play online with friends and join Realms!
translation: Don't have a Gamertag? Create one to earn achievements, play online with friends an' join Realms!

source_string: We tried to sign you in to your Xbox Live account, but something went wrong.
translation: We tried to sign ye in to yer Xbox Live account, but somethin' went wrong.

source_string: If you play without signing in you won't be able to see your friends list, earn achievements, join Realms, or play online on Xbox Live.
translation: If ye play without signin' in ye won't be able to see yer friends list, earn achievements, join Realms, or play online on Xbox Live.

source_string: Achievements and Gamerscore mark your progress through Minecraft.
translation: Achievements an' Gamerscore mark yer progress through Minecraft.

source_string: Sign in to Xbox Live to start earning them!
translation: Sign in to Xbox Live to start earnin' 'em!

source_string: Add a friend to see when they are online and to play online multiplayer without the hassle of IP addresses and ports.
translation: Add a friend to see when they be online an' to play online multiplayer without the hassle o' IP addresses an' ports.

source_string: Sign in to Xbox Live to start adding friends!
translation: Sign in to Xbox Live to start addin' friends!

source_string: Invite your friends to play online multiplayer with you without the hassle of IP address and ports.
translation: Invite yer friends to play online multiplayer with ye without the hassle o' IP address an' ports.

source_string: Sign in to Xbox Live to start inviting friends!
translation: Sign in to Xbox Live to start invitin' friends!

source_string: Servers offer some of the most creative ways to play Minecraft! We just need you to sign in so that we can make sure you have permission to play online with new people.
translation: Servers offer some o' the most creative ways to play Minecraft! We just need ye to sign in so that we can make sure ye have permission to play online with new people.

source_string: Thank you for sending us a copy of your world and helping us find bugs! We are hard at work fixing things and won't be able to get back to you about this specific world. Here's your receipt confirming that we received it: %s
translation: Thank ye for sendin' us a copy o' yer world an' helpin' us find bugs! We be hard at work fixin' things an' won't be able to get back to ye about this specific world. Here's yer receipt confirmin' that we received it: %s

source_string: Oops! We weren't able to receive your world. Try checking your internet connection or sending it again later.
translation: Oops! We weren't able to receive yer world. Try checkin' yer internet connection or sendin' it again later.

source_string: Did your old world not look or work the way it should have? Send us your world and help us find the bugs!
translation: Did yer old world not look or work the way it should have? Send us yer world an' help us find the bugs!

source_string: You can change the look of your character with a Skin Pack from the Store. Select 'Store' on the Main Menu to see what's available.
translation: Ye can change the look o' yer character with a Skin Pack from the Store. Select 'Store' on the Main Menu to see what's available.

source_string: Iron golems will fight for you!
translation: Iron golems will fight for ye!

source_string: Alter the brightness setting to make the game brighter or darker.
translation: Alter the brightness settin' to make the game brighter or darker.

source_string: If you set the game difficulty to Peaceful, your health will automatically regenerate, and no monsters will come out at night!
translation: If ye set the game difficulty to Peaceful, yer health will automatically regenerate, an' no monsters will come out at night!

source_string: Feed a bone to a wolf to tame it. You can then make it sit or follow you.
translation: Feed a bone to a wolf to tame it. Ye can then make it sit or follow ye.

source_string: Wearing a pumpkin on your head will keep Endermen from attacking you.
translation: Wearin' a pumpkin on yer head will keep Endermen from attackin' ye.

source_string: Sleeping in a bed at night will fast forward the game to dawn, but all players in a multiplayer game need to sleep in beds at the same time.
translation: Sleepin' in a bed at night will fast forward the game to dawn, but all players in a multiplayer game need to sleep in beds at the same time.

source_string: Harvest food from pigs, cows, sheep, rabbit, and chickens. Cook and eat it to regain health!
translation: Harvest food from pigs, cows, sheep, rabbit, an' chickens. Cook an' eat it to regain health!

source_string: Harvest leather from cows, and use it to make armor and books.
translation: Harvest leather from cows, an' use it to make armor an' books.

source_string: If you have an empty bucket, you can fill it with water, lava, or milk from a cow!
translation: If ye have an empty bucket, ye can fill it with water, lava, or milk from a cow!

source_string: Use a hoe to prepare areas of ground for planting.
translation: Use a hoe to prepare areas o' ground for plantin'.

source_string: Spiders won't attack you during the day - unless you attack them.
translation: Spiders won't attack ye durin' the day - unless ye attack 'em.

source_string: Feeding an animal will keep it from despawning. Build a pen to keep your animals safe.
translation: Feedin' an animal will keep it from despawnin'. Build a pen to keep yer animals safe.

source_string: Eating cooked food reduces hunger better than eating raw food.
translation: Eatin' cooked food reduces hunger better than eatin' raw food.

source_string: Craft torches to light up dark areas. Monsters lurk in the darkness!
translation: Craft torches to light up dark spots. Monsters lurk in the dark!

source_string: Get to destinations faster with a minecart and rail!
translation: Get to destinations faster with a minecart an' rail!

source_string: Plant some saplings and they'll grow into trees.
translation: Plant some saplings an' they'll grow into trees.

source_string: Pigmen won't attack you - unless you attack them.
translation: Pigmen won't attack ye - unless ye attack 'em.

source_string: You can change your game spawn point, and skip to dawn by sleeping in a bed.
translation: Ye can change yer game spawn point, an' skip to dawn by sleepin' in a bed.

source_string: Hit those fireballs back at the Ghast!
translation: Hit those fireballs back at the Ghast!

source_string: Building a portal will allow you to travel to another dimension - The Nether.
translation: Buildin' a portal will allow ye to travel to another dimension - The Nether.

source_string: Use the right tool for the job! Digging dirt with a shovel is much faster than using a pickaxe!
translation: Use the right tool for the job! Diggin' dirt with a shovel be much faster than usin' a pickaxe!

source_string: If you can't find any coal for your torches, you can always make charcoal from trees in a furnace.
translation: If ye can't find any coal for yer torches, ye can always make charcoal from trees in a furnace.

source_string: Digging straight down or straight up is not a great idea.
translation: Diggin' straight down or straight up be not a great idea.

source_string: Bonemeal (crafted from a Skeleton bone) can be used as a fertilizer and can make things grow instantly!
translation: Bonemeal (crafted from a Skeleton bone) can be used as a fertilizer an' can make things grow instantly!

source_string: Creepers explode when they get close to you!
translation: Creepers explode when they get close to ye!

source_string: Obsidian is created when water hits a lava source block.
translation: Obsidian be created when water hits a lava source block.

source_string: If the source block for water or lava is removed, it will stop the flow completely.
translation: If the source block for water or lava be removed, it will stop the flow completely.

source_string: Cobblestone is resistant to Ghast fireballs, making it useful for guarding portals.
translation: Cobblestone be resistant to Ghast fireballs, makin' it useful for guardin' portals.

source_string: Blocks that can be used as a light source will melt snow and ice. This includes torches, glowstones, and Jack-O-Lanterns.
translation: Blocks that can be used as a light source will melt snow an' ice. This includes torches, glowstones, an' Jack-O-Lanterns.

source_string: Take caution when building structures made of wool out in the open, as lightning from thunderstorms can set wool on fire.
translation: Take caution when buildin' structures made o' wool out in the open, as lightnin' from thunderstorms can set wool on fire.

source_string: A single bucket of lava can be used in a furnace to smelt 100 blocks.
translation: A single bucket o' lava can be used in a furnace to smelt 100 blocks.

source_string: The instrument played by a note block depends on the material beneath it.
translation: The instrument played by a note block depends on the material 'neath it.

source_string: Zombies and Skeletons can survive daylight if they are in water or wearing a helmet.
translation: Zombies an' Skeletons can survive daylight if they be in water or wearin' a helmet.

source_string: Attacking a wolf will cause any wolves in the immediate vicinity to turn hostile and attack you. This trait is also shared by Zombie Pigmen.
translation: Attackin' a wolf will cause any wolves in the immediate vicinity to turn hostile an' attack ye. This trait be also shared by Zombie Pigmen.

source_string: Wolves and Iron Golems won't attack Creepers.
translation: Wolves an' Iron Golems won't attack Creepers.

source_string: Chickens lay an egg every 5 to 10 minutes.
translation: Chickens lay an egg every 5 to 10 minutes.

source_string: Obsidian can only be mined with a diamond pickaxe.
translation: Obsidian can only be mined with a diamond pickaxe.

source_string: Creepers are the easiest obtainable source of gunpowder.
translation: Creepers are the eathest spryng of gundust.

source_string: Placing two chests side by side will make one large chest.
translation: Placin' two chests side by side will make one large chest.

source_string: Tame wolves show their health with the position of their tail. Feed them meat to heal them.
translation: Tame wolves show their health with the position o' their tail. Feed 'em meat to heal 'em.

source_string: Different colored dyes can be made from a variety of materials, cook cactus in a furnace to get green dye!
translation: Different colored dyes can be made from a variety o' materials, cook cactus in a furnace to get green dye!

source_string: On mobile devices, you can download the "Music by Minecraft" pack from the Music Category in the Minecraft Store.
translation: On mobile devices, ye can download the "Music by Minecraft" pack from the Music Category in the Minecraft Store.

source_string: Some animals will follow you if you have wheat in your hand.
translation: Some animals will follow ye if ye have wheat in yer hand.

source_string: There will be an update to this game eventually!
translation: There'll be an update to this game eventually!

source_string: Mojang has more awards than staff!
translation: Mojang has more awards than crew!

source_string: Do not look directly at the bugs.
translation: Don't look directly at the bugs, matey.

source_string: Creepers were born from a coding bug.
translation: Creepers were born from a codin' bug.

source_string: Is it a chicken or is it a duck?
translation: Be it a chicken or be it a duck?

source_string: No-one at Mojang has ever seen Junkboy's face.
translation: No-one at Mojang has ever seen Junkboy's face.

source_string: Did you know there's a Minecraft Wiki?
translation: Did ye know there be a Minecraft Wiki?

source_string: MINECON 2011 was in Las Vegas, Nevada, USA!
translation: MINECON 2011 be in Las Vegas, Nevada, USA!

source_string: MINECON 2013 was in Orlando, Florida, USA!
translation: MINECON 2013 be in Orlando, Florida, USA!

source_string: No-one can remember where MINECON 2014 was held.
translation: No-one can recall where MINECON 2014 be held.

source_string: MINECON 2016 was in Anaheim, California, USA!
translation: MINECON 2016 be in Anaheim, California, USA!

source_string: Always assume rumors are false, rather than assuming they're true!
translation: Always assume rumors be false, rather than assumin' they be true!

source_string: The first version of Minecraft was created in just 6 days!
translation: The first version o' Minecraft were made in just 6 days!

source_string: The Enderman language is actually English in reverse.
translation: The Enderman tongue be actually English backwards.

source_string: The original name for Minecraft was Cave Game.
translation: The original name fer Minecraft were Cave Game.

source_string: Pigs that are struck by lightning become Zombie Pigmen!
translation: Pigs struck by lightnin' become Zombie Pigmen!

source_string: Sometimes iron golems give flowers to the villager children!
translation: Sometimes iron golems give flowers to the villager young'uns!

source_string: A Spider Jockey is the rare appearance of a spider being ridden by a skeleton!
translation: A Spider Jockey be the rare sight of a spider bein' ridden by a skeleton!

source_string: Traveling one block in the Nether is equal to traveling eight blocks in the overworld.
translation: Travelin' one block in the Nether be equal to travelin' eight blocks in the overworld.

source_string: You need an Agent to code! Get an Agent egg from your creative inventory.
translation: Ye need an Agent to code! Grab an Agent egg from yer creative inventory.

source_string: Sign in to Xbox Live to sync your Skins, Texture Packs, Worlds, and Mash-ups. They will be there for you on any device where you play Minecraft.
translation: Sign in to Xbox Live to sync yer Skins, Texture Packs, Worlds, and Mash-ups. They'll be there fer ye on any device where ye play Minecraft.

source_string: Syncing purchases to Xbox Live account...
translation: Syncin' purchases to Xbox Live account...

source_string: This Xbox Live account will not be the primary account for this device if you do not sync this device's purchases to this account. You will not automatically sign in when you start Minecraft.
translation: This Xbox Live account won't be the primary account fer this device if ye don't sync this device's purchases to this account. Ye won't automatically sign in when ye start Minecraft.

source_string: Your app store purchases will be available wherever you log in with %s. You can only sync these packs to one account, but they will continue to be available to anyone who uses this device.
translation: Yer app store purchases will be available wherever ye log in with %s. Ye can only sync these packs to one account, but they'll keep bein' available to anyone who uses this device.

source_string: Is this the account that you would like to use to access your previous purchases?
translation: Be this the account ye'd like to use to access yer previous purchases?

source_string: You can't extend your Realm right now. We have now introduced subscriptions for Realms on Xbox and you can buy a new subscription as soon as your Realm has expired in %d days. But don't worry! We will give you 14 extra days for free and your Realm will be kept online, so you will have plenty of time to extend it by then.
translation: Ye can't extend yer Realm right now. We've now brought in subscriptions fer Realms on Xbox and ye can buy a new subscription as soon as yer Realm's expired in %d days. But don't fret! We'll give ye 14 extra days fer free and yer Realm'll be kept online, so ye'll have plenty o' time to extend it by then.

source_string: How to Play : Education Edition Blocks
translation: How to Play : Education Edition Blocks

source_string: Minecraft: Education Edition features several special blocks that make it easier for teachers to create and employ lessons. World Builder ability negates the restrictions of these blocks.
translation: Minecraft: Education Edition features several special blocks that make it easier fer teachers to create and employ lessons. World Builder ability negates the restrictions o' these blocks.

source_string: Allow and Deny blocks focus where players can build in a world.
translation: Allow and Deny blocks focus where players can build in a world.

source_string: Allow blocks let players place or destroy blocks in the area above them.
translation: Allow blocks let players place or destroy blocks in the area above 'em.

source_string: Deny blocks prohibit users from placing or destroying blocks in the area above them.
translation: Deny blocks stop users from placin' or destroyin' blocks in the area above 'em.

source_string: Neither block affects the area below them.
translation: Neither block affects the area below 'em.

source_string: If an Allow block is placed somewhere with a Deny block below it, the space between the two blocks will be protected while the space above the Allow block will permit users to place and destroy blocks.
translation: If an Allow block be placed somewhere with a Deny block below it, the space between the two blocks'll be protected while the space above the Allow block'll let users place and destroy blocks.

source_string: Border Blocks are bright, red walls that act like a force field, extending upwards and downwards forever!
translation: Border Blocks be bright, red walls that act like a force field, extendin' upwards and downwards forever!

source_string: Border blocks prevent players from passing through, over, or under them by any means other than being a World Builder.
translation: Border blocks stop players from passin' through, over, or under 'em by any means other than bein' a World Builder.

source_string: Border blocks cannot be destroyed by non-World Builders.
translation: Border blocks can't be destroyed by non-World Builders.

source_string: Structure blocks save existing structures so they can be loaded in a different spot or even exported for later use.
translation: Structure blocks save existin' structures so they can be loaded in a different spot or even exported fer later use.

source_string: NPCs display their dialog text when interacted with by non-World Builders.
translation: NPCs show their dialog text when messed with by non-World Builders.

source_string: NPCs can also launch external URLs or execute commands automatically on closing their dialog box, or by assigning actions to buttons for players to interact with. All automatic commands (and URLs) are executed in the order they are added to the NPC.
translation: NPCs can also launch outside URLs or run commands automatically on closin' their dialog box, or by assignin' actions to buttons fer players to interact with. All automatic commands (and URLs) run in the order they be added to the NPC.

source_string: Once placed, face the Camera and press the on-screen button labeled "Take Picture".
translation: Once placed, face the Camera and press the on-screen button labeled "Take Picture".

source_string: The Camera will track you during this time, doing its best to keep you in the shot, even if you move around.
translation: The Camera'll track ye durin' this time, doin' its best to keep ye in the shot, even if ye move about.

source_string: After the five second timer counts down, your picture is taken.
translation: After the five second timer counts down, yer picture be taken.

source_string: Pictures can be viewed in the Portfolio or inserted into a book using the Book & Quill.
translation: Pictures can be viewed in the Portfolio or inserted into a book usin' the Book & Quill.

source_string: You can caption your pictures by pressing :mouse_left_button: on the caption label.
translation: Ye can caption yer pictures by pressin' :mouse_left_button: on the caption label.

source_string: You can caption your pictures by selecting the caption label and pressing :_gamepad_face_button_down: .
translation: Ye can caption yer pictures by selectin' the caption label and pressin' :_gamepad_face_button_down: .

source_string: You can caption your pictures by tapping the caption label.
translation: Ye can caption yer pictures by tappin' the caption label.

source_string: You can delete your pictures by pressing :mouse_left_button: on the trash icon below the picture.
translation: Ye can delete yer pictures by pressin' :mouse_left_button: on the trash icon below the picture.

source_string: You can delete your pictures by selecting the trash icon below the picture and pressing :_gamepad_face_button_down: .
translation: Ye can delete yer pictures by selectin' the trash icon below the picture and pressin' :_gamepad_face_button_down: .

source_string: You can delete your pictures by tapping the trash icon below the picture.
translation: Ye can delete yer pictures by tappin' the trash icon below the picture.

source_string: You can export your Portfolio as a series of images by pressing :mouse_left_button: on the Export Portfolio button.
translation: Ye can export yer Portfolio as a series o' images by pressin' :mouse_left_button: on the Export Portfolio button.

source_string: You can export your Portfolio as a series of images by selecting the Export Portfolio button and pressing :_gamepad_face_button_down: .
translation: Ye can export yer Portfolio as a series o' images by selectin' the Export Portfolio button and pressin' :_gamepad_face_button_down: .

source_string: You can export your Portfolio as a series of images by tapping the Export Portfolio button.
translation: Ye can export yer Portfolio as a series o' images by tappin' the Export Portfolio button.

source_string: Code Connection is an extension that allows educators and students to explore, create, and play in an immersive Minecraft world... all by writing code!
translation: Code Connection be an extension that lets educators and students explore, create, and play in an immersive Minecraft world... all by writin' code!

source_string: You can launch Code Connection using the command "/code" to get started.
translation: Ye can launch Code Connection usin' the command "/code" to get started.

source_string: Scaffolding can help you create huge structures safely! You can walk inside scaffolding and stand on it. If you have a column of scaffolding you can go upward by standing in the scaffolding and pressing the :touch_jump: button. If you want to travel downward you can press the :touch_fly_down: button.
translation: Scaffoldin' can help ye create huge structures safely! Ye can walk inside scaffoldin' and stand on it. source_string: Custom Dimensions - Add custom void dimensions to your world. New dimensions will appear in both the Custom Dimensions panel and the World/Dimensions menu.
translation: Custom Dimensions - Add custom void dimensions t' yer world. New dimensions will appear in both the Custom Dimensions panel an' the World/Dimensions menu.

source_string: Biome Data Assignment - Assign biome metadata to a selection, including within Custom Dimensions. This affects systems like weather, spawning rules, and Vibrant Visuals but does not place or alter blocks.
translation: Biome Data Assignment - Assign biome metadata t' a selection, includin' within Custom Dimensions. This affects systems like weather, spawnin' rules, an' Vibrant Visuals but does not place or alter blocks.

source_string: Vibrant Visuals: Biome Config Mapping - Easily mix and match Vibrant Visual settings across multiple biomes using the new config mapping window. Find it in the Vibrant Visuals panel: [~*icon|$val=pack://textures/editor/Vibrant-Visuals.png~]
translation: Vibrant Visuals: Biome Config Mapping - Easily mix an' match Vibrant Visual settin's across multiple biomes usin' the new config mappin' window. Find it in the Vibrant Visuals panel: [~*icon|$val=pack://textures/editor/Vibrant-Visuals.png~]

source_string: Cursor improvements - We've added contextual cursors to improve feedback. You should now see a "loading" icon when you're blocked from taking action by something that requires processing time, such as chunk regeneration or placing a very large primitive shape.
translation: Cursor improvements - We've added contextual cursors t' improve feedback. Ye should now see a "loading" icon when ye're blocked from takin' action by somethin' that requires processin' time, such as chunk regeneration or placin' a very large primitive shape.

source_string: %s Use "Import Custom Mesh" to choose a 3D mesh on your hard drive that you've downloaded or exported from a modeling program.%s You can move, rotate and scale the mesh preview in your world using the viewport widget and the sliders in the tool panel.%s "Place Blocks" will turn your mesh into a shell of blocks using your active hotbar selection.%s "Cancel" will clear the loaded mesh
translation: %s Use "Import Custom Mesh" t' choose a 3D mesh on yer hard drive that ye've downloaded or exported from a modeling program.%s Ye can move, rotate an' scale the mesh preview in yer world usin' the viewport widget an' the sliders in the tool panel.%s "Place Blocks" will turn yer mesh into a shell o' blocks usin' yer active hotbar selection.%s "Cancel" will clear the loaded mesh

source_string: %s Add your own Custom Dimensions with the "Add Custom Dimension" button.%s Dimension names must include a namespace, such as "namespace:mydimension".%s Click on any dimension in the list to visit it and start placing blocks. You can also find them in the World/Dimensions menu.%s Custom dimensions cannot currently be renamed or deleted.
translation: %s Add yer own Custom Dimensions with the "Add Custom Dimension" button.%s Dimension names must include a namespace, such as "namespace:mydimension".%s Click on any dimension in the list t' visit it an' start placin' blocks. Ye can also find them in the World/Dimensions menu.%s Custom dimensions cannot currently be renamed or deleted.

source_string: %s Biome Data Assignment lets you assign a selection to the biome of your choice.%s This does not add or change any blocks, but will affect game systems like vegetation tint, mob spawning, Vibrant Visuals, and weather.%s Choose a biome in the "Biome to Assign" box, and use the "Assign Biome to Selection" to reassign data.
translation: %s Biome Data Assignment lets ye assign a selection t' the biome o' yer choice.%s This does not add or change any blocks, but will affect game systems like vegetation tint, mob spawnin', Vibrant Visuals, an' weather.%s Choose a biome in the "Biome t' Assign" box, an' use the "Assign Biome t' Selection" t' reassign data.

source_string: %s You'll be reassigning a selection in the world. Within the Biome Data Assignment panel, you can use additional settings to determine how the data reassignment will interact with that selection.%s "Extend up to world ceiling" and "Extend down to world floor" will extend the effect on the Y axis, including all blocks above or below your selection respectively.%s Masking your selection by Biomes or Biome Tags will use existing Biome boundaries to restrict the effect further. These settings will not extend data assignment beyond your selection, but can provide further control.%s By default, the list of available biomes and tags will be filtered to show only valid options within your existing selection. Uncheck "Only show biomes/tags within the active selection" to see the full list.
translation: %s Ye'll be reassignin' a selection in the world. Within the Biome Data Assignment panel, ye can use additional settin's t' determine how the data reassignment will interact with that selection.%s "Extend up t' world ceiling" an' "Extend down t' world floor" will extend the effect on the Y axis, includin' all blocks above or below yer selection respectively.%s Maskin' yer selection by Biomes or Biome Tags will use existin' Biome boundaries t' restrict the effect further. These settin's will not extend data assignment beyond yer selection, but can provide further control.%s By default, the list o' available biomes an' tags will be filtered t' show only valid options within yer existin' selection. Uncheck "Only show biomes/tags within the active selection" t' see the full list.

source_string: %s Any areas you've already reassigned will be listed here. Each item shows you the region's current biome assignment, its rough center (in X and Z), and the full height in Y, so you can determine whether the affected area extends to the world ceiling or floor.%s Use %s to move your camera to that location.%s Use %s to change the assignment of that area to another biome.%s It is not currently possible to revert a reassigned area to the world's original state.
translation: %s Any areas ye've already reassigned will be listed here. Each item shows ye the region's current biome assignment, its rough center (in X an' Z), an' the full height in Y, so ye can determine whether the affected area extends t' the world ceiling or floor.%s Use %s t' move yer camera t' that location.%s Use %s t' change the assignment o' that area t' another biome.%s It is not currently possible t' revert a reassigned area t' the world's original state.
